a: Lehaveriach mayim asuyot.
Verabba, may tama la amar kerabbi zera? bimhallechet — kulle alma la feligi. ki peligi besheamda.

Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: matnitin name dayka devimhallechet la peligi. mimmay? middekatane: maase shebbau mippelandarsin vehifliga sefinatam bayyam. rabban gamliel verabbi elazar ben azarya halchu et kullah, verabbi yehoshua verabbi akiva lo zazu mearba ammot, sheratzu lehachamir al atzman.
I amrat bishlama bimhallechet la peligi — hayeynu dekatane "ratzu", dilma amda.
Ella i amrat peligi, hay "ratzu lehachamir" — issura hu!
Amar rav ashe: matnitin name dayka, dekatane: sefina, duvmya dedir vesahar. ma dir vesahar — dikvii, af sefina name dikvia.
Amar leh rav acha bereh derava lerav ashe: hilcheta kerabban gamliel bisfina, hilcheta mikkelal difligi!
In, vehatanya chananya (ben achi rabbi yehoshua) omer: kol oto hayyom yashvu vedanu bidvar halacha, emesh hichria achi abba halacha kerabban gamliel bisfina, vahalacha kerabbi akiva bedir vesahar.
Bae rav chananya: yesh techumin lemala measara, o en techumin lemala measara?
Ammud gavoah asara verachav arbaa, la tibbee lach — deara semichta hi.
Ki tibbee lach, beammud gavoah asara veeno rachav arbaa. i name, dekaazel bikfitza.
Lishshana acharina: bisfina, may?
Amar rav hoshaya, ta shema: maase shebbau mippelandarsin vehifliga sefinatam bayyam vechulei, i amrat bishlama yesh techumin — mishshum hachi ratzu. ella, i amrat en techumin — ammay ratzu?!
Kidamar rava — bimhallechet birkak, hacha name — bimhallechet birkak.
Ta shema: paam achat lo nichnesu lannamal ad shechashecha vechulei. i amrat bishlama yesh techumin — shappir, ella i amrat en techumin — ki lo hayinu betoch hattechum, may have!
Amar rava: bimhallechet birkak.
Ta shema: hane shav shemata deitamran betzafra beshabbeta kammeh derav chisda besura, bahade panya beshabbeta kammeh derava befumebdita.
Man amrinhu? lav eliyyahu amrinhu? alma en techumin lemala measara! la, dilma yosef sheda amrinhu.
Ta shema: hareni nazir bayyom shebben david ba — muttar lishtot yayin beshabbatot uveyamim tovim,
b: Veasur lishtot yayin kol yemot hachol.
I amrat bishlama yesh techumin — hayeynu divshabbatot uveyamim tovim muttar. ella i amrat en techumin, beshabbatot uveyamim tovim ammay muttar?
Shane hatam, deamar kera: "hinne anochi sholeach lachem et eliyya hannavi vegomer", veha la ata eliyyahu meetmol.
I hachi, bechol kol yoma veyoma name lishtere, deha la ata eliyyahu meetmol? ella amrinan: levet din haggadol ata. hacha name lema: levet din haggadol ata?
Kevar muvetach lahen leyisrael sheen eliyyahu ba lo bearve shabbatot velo bearve yamim tovim, mippene hattorach.
Ka salka datach middeeliyyahu la ata, mashiach name la ate, bemaale shabbeta lishtere! eliyyahu la ate, mashiach ate. dechevan deate meshicha — hakkol avadim hen leyisrael.
Bechad beshabba lishtere? lifshot minna deen techumin, dei yesh techumin — bechad beshabba lishtere, dela ata eliyyahu beshabbat?!
Hay tanna sappoke mesappeka leh i yesh techumin o en techumin, ulechumera.
Dekae emat deka nadar? illema dekae bechol — kevan dechal aleh nezirut, hechi atya shabbeta umafkea leh?
Ella dekae beshabbeta veka nadar, uveyom tov veka nadar, vehahu yoma deshare leh, mikkan veelach — asir leh.
Paam achat lo nichnesu lannamal vechulei.
Tana: shefoferet hayta lo lerabban gamliel shehaya mabbit vetzofe bah alpayim amma bayyabbasha, uchenegdah alpayim bayyam.
Harotze leda kamma omko shel ge, mevi shefoferet umabbit bah, veyeda kamma omko shel gay.
Veharotze leda kamma govho shel dekel — moded komato vetzillo, vetzel komato veyeda kamma gova shel dekel.
Harotze shello tishre chayya raa betzel kever — noetz kane bearba shaot bayyom, veyire lehechan tzillo note, meshappea veole meshappea veyored.
Nechemya bereh derav chanilay meshachteh shemata, unefak chutz lattechum. amar leh rav chisda lerav nachman: nechemya talmidcha sharuy betzaar.
Amar lo: ase lo mechitza shel bene adam, veyikkanes.
Yatev rav nachman bar yitzchak achoreh derava, veyatev rava kammeh derav nachman. amar leh rav nachman bar yitzchak lerava: may ka mibbaya leh lerav chisda?
Illema bidmalu gavre askinan, veka mibbaya leh: hilcheta kerabban gamliel,

a: O en halacha kerabban gamliel. o dilma, bidla malu gavre askinan, veka mibbaya leh: halacha kerabbi eliezer, o en halacha kerabbi eliezer?

Peshita bidla malu gavre askinan, dei salka datach bidmalu gavre askinan, may tibbee leh? haamar rav: halacha kerabban gamliel bedir vesahar usefina! ella vadday bidla malu gavre askinan, uderabbi eliezer kamibbaya leh.
Dayka name, dekaamar leh "yikkanes". may "yikkanes" — lav belo mechitza?!

Etiveh rav nachman bar yitzchak lerava: nafal dofnah — lo yaamid bah adam behema vechelim. velo yizkof et hammitta lifros aleha sadin, lefi sheen osin ohel aray battechilla beyom tov, veen tzarich lomar bashshabbat.

Amar leh: at amrat li meha, vaana amena lach meha: ose adam et chavero dofen kede sheyyochal veyishte veyishan. veyizkof et hammitta veyifros aleha sadin kede shello tippol chamma al hammet veal haochalin.

Kashyayn ahadade! la kashya: ha — rabbi eliezer, ha — rabbanan, ditnan: pekak hachallon, rabbi eliezer omer: bizman shekkashur vetaluy — pokkin bo, veim lav — en pokkin bo. vachachamim omrim: ben kach uven kach pokkin bo.

Veha: ittemar ala, amar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan: hakkol modim sheen osin ohel aray battechilla beyom tov, veen tzarich lomar beshabbat. lo nechleku ella lehosif, sherabbi eliezer omer: en mosifin beyom tov, veen tzarich lomar beshabbat. vachachamim omrim: mosifin beshabbat, veen tzarich lomar beyom tov!
Ella la kashya: ha — kerabbi meir, ha — kerabbi yehuda. detanya: asaah livhema dofen lassukka, rabbi meir posel, verabbi yehuda machshir.
Rabbi meir deka pasel hatam — alma la mechitza hi, hacha share, delav midde ka aved.
Verabbi yehuda deka machshir hatam — alma mechitza hi, hacha asar.
Vetisbera? emar deshamat leh lerabbi meir behema. adam vechelim mi shamat leh?
Vetu — rabbi meir allibba deman? i allibba derabbi eliezer — lehosif name asar.
Ella allibba derabbanan, emar deamri rabbanan lehosif, lechattechilla mi amur?
Ella: ha veha rabbanan. vechelim akkelim la kashya, ha — bedofen shelishit, ha — bedofen reviit.
Dayka name, dekatane: nafal dofnah. shema minna.
b: Ella adam aadam kashya!
Adam aadam name la kashya: kan — ledaat, kan — shello middaat.
Veha derabbi nechemya bereh derabbi chanilay, ledaat hava! shello middaat hava.
Rav chisda, miha ledaat hava! rav chisda, shello min hamminyan hava.
Hanhu bene genana deailu mayya bimchitza shel bene adam. naggedinhu shemuel. amar: im amru shello middaat, yomru ledaat?!
Hanhu zike dahava shadyayn beristeka demachoza, bahade daata rava mippirkeh, alinhu nihaleh. leshabbeta achariti bae ayyeylinhu, vaasar lehu, dehave leh kildaat — veasur.
Levi, ailu leh tivna, zeeri — aspasta, rav shimi bar chiyyay — mayya.
Mishna mi sheyyatza birshut, veamru lo: "kevar naasa maase" — yesh lo alpayim amma lechol ruach.
Im haya betoch hattechum — keillu lo yatza. kol hayyotzim lehatztzil — chozrin limkoman.
Gemara may "im haya betoch hattechum keillu lo yatza"? amar rabba, hachi kaamar: im haya betoch techum shello — keillu lo yatza mittoch beto dame.
Peshita? mahu detema: hoil veakar — akar, ka mashma lan.
Rav shimi bar chiyyay amar, hachi kaamar: im hayu techumin shennatnu lo chachamim muvelain betoch hattechum shello, keillu lo yatza mittechumo.
Bemay kamippalgi? mar savar havelaat techumin milleta hi, umar savar lav milleta hi.

Amar leh abbaye lerabba: veat la tisbera dehavlaat techumin milleta hi? uma illu shavat bimara, shebbetochah arbaat alafim veal gaggah pachot mearbaat alafim amma — lo nimtza mehallech et kullah, vechutza lah alpayim amma?
Amar leh: vela shane lach ben hecha deshavat baavir mechitztzot mibbeod yom, lehecha delo shavat baavir mechitztzot mibbeod yom?
Vehecha delo shavat, la?

a: Vehatnan rabbi eliezer omer: shetayim — yikkanes, shelosha — lo yikkanes. may lav, rabbi eliezer letameh deamar vehu beemtzaan —
Vearba ammot dihavu leh rabbanan keman demibbalan damu, vekaamar "yikkanes" — alma havelaat techumin milleta hi.

Amar leh rabba bar bar chana leabbaye: umidderabbi eliezer kamotvat leh lemar? amar leh: in, dishmia li minneh demar: ad kan la peligi rabbanan aleh derabbi eliezer ella lidvar harshut, aval lidvar mitzva modu leh.
Vechol hayyotzin lehatztzil chozrin limkoman. vaafillu tuva? veha amrat resha: "alpayim amma", vetu la!
Amar rav yehuda amar rav: shechozrin bichle zayin limkoman. umay kusheya? dilma lehatztzil shane!
Ella i kashya, ha kashya: ditnan barishona lo hayu zazin mishsham kol hayyom kullo.

Hitkin rabban gamliel hazzaken sheyyesh lahen alpayim amma lechol ruach. velo ellu bilvad amru, ella afillu chachama habbaa leyalled, vehabba lehatztzil min haggayis umin hannahar umin hammappolet umin haddeleka — hare hen keanshe hair, veyesh lahen alpayim amma lechol ruach.
Vetu la? veha amrat: kol hayyotzin lehatztzil chozrin limkoman — afillu tuva!
Amar rav [yehuda amar rav]: shechozrin bichle zayin limkoman, kidtanya: barishona hayu mannichin kele zeynan babbayit hassamuch lachoma.

Paam achat hikkiru bahen oyvim veradfu acharehem, venichnesu littol kele zeynan, venichnesu oyvim acharehen. dachaku ze et ze, vehargu ze et ze yoter mimma shehargu oyvim. beotah shaa hitkinu sheyyehu chozrin limkoman bichle zeynan.
Rav nachman bar yitzchak amar: la kashya. kan — shennitztzechu yisrael et ummot haolam, kan — shennitztzechu ummot haolam et atzman.
Amar rav yehuda amar rav: nochrim shetztzaru al ayyrot yisrael — en yotzin alehem bichle zeynan, veen mechallelin alehen et hashshabbat.
Tanya name hachi nochrim shetztzaru vechulei. bamme devarim amurim, keshebbau al iske mamon, aval bau al iske nefashot — yotzin alehen bichle zeynan, umechallelin alehen et hashshabbat.
Uvair hassemucha lassefar, afillu lo bau al iske nefashot ella al iske teven vakash — yotzin alehen bichle zeynan, umechallelin alehen et hashshabbat.
Amar rav yosef bar minyome amar rav nachman: uvavel, kair hassemucha lassefar damya. vetarguma: nehardea.
Daresh rabbi dostay demin bere: may dichtiv: "vayyaggidu ledavid lemor hinne felishtim nilchamim bikila vehemma shosim et haggoranot".

Tana: keila ir hassemucha lassefar hayta, vehem lo bau ella al iske teven vakash, dichtiv: "vehemma shosim et haggoranot". uchetiv "vayyishal david baAdonai lemor haelech vehikketi bappelishtim haelle vayyomer Adonai el david lech vehikkita vappelishtim vehoshata et keila".
May kamibbaya leh? illema i shere i asur — hare bet dino shel shemuel haramati kayyaym.
Ella: i matzlach i la matzlach. dayka name, dichtiv: "lech vehikkita vappelishtim vehoshata et keila", shema minna.
Mishna mi sheyyashav badderech, veamad veraa hare (ze) hu samuch lair, [hoil] velo hayta kauonato lechach — lo yikkanes. divre rabbi meir.
Rabbi yehuda omer: yikkanes. amar rabbi yehuda: maase haya venichnas rabbi tarfon belo mitkavven.

Gemara tanya, amar rabbi yehuda: maase berabbi tarfon shehaya mehallech badderech vechashcha lo, velan chutz lair. leshacharit metzauhu roe vakar, amru lo: rabbi, hare hair lefanecha, hikkanes! nichnas veyashav bevet hammidrash, vedarash kol hayyom kullo.
(Amru lo): mishsham reayay? shemma belibbo hayta, o bet hammidrash muvela betoch techumo haya.
Mishna mi sheyyashan badderech vela yada shechashecha — yesh lo alpayim amma lechol ruach, divre rabbi yochanan ben nuri.
Vachachamim omrim: en lo ella arba ammot. rabbi eliezer omer: vehu beemtzaan.
Rabbi yehuda omer: leeze ruach sheyyirtze yelech. umode rabbi yehuda sheim berar lo, sheeno yachol lachazor bo.
Hayu shenayim, miktzat ammotav shel ze betoch ammotav shel ze — meviin veochlin baemtza,
b: Uvilvad shello yotzi ze mittoch shello letoch shel chavero.
Hayu shelosha vehaemtzai muvela benehen — hu muttar immahen, vehen muttarin immo, ushenayim hachitzonim asurin ze im ze.

Amar rabbi shimon: lema haddavar dome — leshalosh chatzerot happetuchot zo lazo, ufetuchot lirshut harabbim. ervu shetayim im haemtzait — hi mutteret immahen vehem muttarot immah, ushetayim hachitzonot asurot zo im zo.
Gemara bae rava: may kasavar rabbi yochanan ben nuri? misbar ka savar: cheftze hefker konin shevita.
Uvedin hu deliflog bechelim. veha dekamippalgi beadam — lehodiacha kochan derabbanan, deaf al gav deikka lememar: hoil veneor kana, yashen name kana, ka mashma lan dela.
O dilma, kasavar rabbi yochanan ben nuri bealma: cheftze hefker en konin shevita, vehacha hayeynu tama: hoil veneor kana, yashen name kana?
Amar rav yosef, ta shema: geshamim sheyyardu meerev yom tov — yesh lahen alpayim amma lechol ruach. beyom tov — hare hen keragle kol adam.
I amrat bishlama kasavar rabbi yochanan ben nuri: "cheftze hefker konin shevita", ha manni — rabbi yochanan hi.
Ella i amrat: "cheftze hefker en konin shevita", ha manni? la rabbi yochanan velo rabbanan!
Yetev abbaye vekaamar la leha shemata. amar leh rav safra leabbaye: vedilma bigshamim hassemuchin lair askinan, veanshe otah hair datam illayyhu!
Amar leh: la salka datach, ditnan: bor shel yachid — keragle yachid, veshel otah hair — keragle otah hair, veshel ole bavel — keragle hamemalle.
Vetanya: bor shel shevatim — yesh lahen alpayim amma lechol ruach. kashyayn ahadade!
Ella lav, shema minna: ha — rabbi yochanan ben nuri, ha — rabbanan.

Ki ata lekammeh derav yosef, amar leh: hachi kaamar rav safra, vehachi ahdari leh. amar leh: veammay la tema leh miggufa? i salka datach geshamim hassemuchin lair askinan — hay "yesh lahen alpayim amma lechol ruach"?!
Ha "keragle anshe otah hair" mibbaya leh!
Amar mar: beyom tov — hare hen keragle kol adam. veammay? likne shevita beokyaynos.
Lema dela kerabbi eliezer, dei kerabbi eliezer — ha amar: kol haolam kullo mimme okyaynos hu shote!
Amar rabbi yitzchak: hacha beavim shennitkashsheru meerev yom tov askinan.
Vedilma hanach azli, vehanach acharine ninhu? deit lehu simana begavvayyhu.
Veibbaet ema: have safek dedivrehem, vesafek dedivrehem lehakel.
Velikni shevita beavim! tifshot minna, deen techumin lemala measara. dei yesh techumin likne shevita beavim!
Leolam ema lach: yesh techumin, umayya beeva mivla belii.

a: Kol shekken dehavu lehu nolad, daasiri!
Ella: mayya beavim menad nayydi. hasheta deatet lehachi, okyaynos name la liksho lach, mayya beokyaynos name menad nayydi, vetanya: neharot hammoshchin umayaynot hannovin hare hen keragle kol adam.

Amar rabbi yaakov bar idde amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: halacha kerabbi yochanan ben nuri. amar leh rabbi zera lerabbi yaakov bar idi: beferush shemia lach o mikkelala shemia lach? amar leh: beferush shemia li.
May kelala? deamar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: halacha kedivre hammekel beeruv.
Vetarte lema li?!
Amar rabbi zera: tzerichi, dei ashmeinan halacha kerabbi yochanan ben nuri, hava amena ben lekulla uven lechumera, ka mashma lan halacha kedivre hammekel beeruv.
Velema "halacha kedivre hammekel beeruv". halacha kerabbi yochanan ben nuri lema li?
Itzterich, salka datach amena hane mille yachid bimkom yachid verabbim bimkom rabbim, aval yachid bimkom rabbim — ema la.
Amar leh rava leabbaye: mikkede eruvin derabbanan, ma li yachid bimkom yachid, uma li yachid bimkom rabbim!
Amar leh rav pappa lerava: uvidrabbanan la shane lan ben yachid bimkom yachid leyachid bimkom rabbim!
Vehatnan, rabbi elazar omer: kol ishsha sheavru aleha shalosh onot — dayyay sheatah.
Vetanya: maase veasa rabbi kerabbi elazar. leachar shennizkar, amar: keday hu rabbi elazar lismoch alav bishat haddechak.
May "leachar shennizkar"? illema: leachar shennizkar deen halacha kerabbi elazar ella kerabbanan — bishat haddechak hechi aved kevoteh!
Ella: dela ittemar hilcheta la kerabbi elazar vela kerabbanan. "leachar shennizkar" delav yachid pelig aleh ella rabbim peligi aleh, amar: keday hu rabbi elazar lismoch alav bishat haddechak.
Amar rav mesharsheya lerava, veamri la rav nachman bar yitzchak lerava: uvidrabbanan la shane ben yachid bimkom yachid, ben yachid bimkom rabbim?
Vehatanya: shemua kerova noheget shiva usheloshim, rechoka enah noheget ella yom echad.
Vee zo hi kerova veezo hi rechoka? betoch sheloshim — kerova, leachar sheloshim — rechoka, divre rabbi akiva. vachachamim omrim: achat shemua kerova veachat shemua rechoka noheget shiva usheloshim.

Veamar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan: kol makom sheatta motze yachid mekel verabbim mechamirin, halacha kedivre hammachmirin hamerubbim, chutz mizzo, sheaf al pi sherabbi akiva mekel vachachamim mechamirin — halacha kedivre rabbi akiva.
Vesavar la kishmuel, deamar shemuel: halacha kedivre hammekel beevel.
Baavelut hu deakkilu ba rabbanan, aval bealma — afillu bidrabbanan shane ben yachid bimkom yachid ben yachid bimkom rabbim.
b: Verav pappa amar, itzterich, salka datach amena: hane mille beeruve chatzerot, aval beeruve techumin — ema la tzericha.

Umena temra deshane lan ben eruve chatzerot leeruve techumin — ditnan, amar rabbi yehuda: bamme devarim amurim — beeruve techumin, aval beeruve chatzerot mearvin ben ledaat uven shello ledaat, shezzachin leadam shello befanav, veen chavin leadam ella befanav.
Rav ashe amar: itzterich, salka datach amena, hane mille beshiyyure eruv, aval bitchillat eruv — ema la.
Umena temra deshane lan ben shiyyure eruv litchillat eruv — ditnan, amar rabbi yose: bamme devarim amurim — bitchillat eruv, aval beshiyyure eruv — afillu kol shehu.
Velo amru learev chatzerot, ella kede shello leshakkeach torat eruv min hattinokot.
Rabbi yaakov verabbi zerika amru: halacha kerabbi akiva mechavero, ucherabbi yose mechaverav, ucherabbi mechavero.
Lemay hilcheta? rabbi assi amar: halacha. verabbi chiyyay bar abba amar: mattin. verabbi yose berabbi chanina amar: nirin.

Kallashon hazze amar rabbi yaakov bar idde amar rabbi yochanan: rabbi meir verabbi yehuda — halacha kerabbi yehuda, rabbi yehuda verabbi yose — halacha kerabbi yose. veen tzarich lomar rabbi meir verabbi yose — halacha kerabbi yose. hasheta bimkom rabbi yehuda leta, bimkom rabbi yose mibbaya?!

Amar rav assi: af ani lomed: rabbi yose verabbi shimon — halacha kerabbi yose, deamar rabbi abba amar rabbi yochanan: rabbi yehuda verabbi shimon — halacha kerabbi yehuda. hasheta bimkom rabbi yehuda leta, bimkom rabbi yose mibbaya?
Ibbaya lehu: rabbi meir verabbi shimon, may? teku.
Amar rav mesharsheya: letanhu lehane kelale. mena leh lerav mesharsheya ha?

Illema meha ditnan: rabbi shimon omer lema haddavar dome — leshalosh chatzerot happetuchot zo lazo ufetuchot lirshut harabbim. ervu shetayim hachitzonot im haemtzait — hi mutteret immahen vehen muttarot immah, ushetayim hachitzonot asurot zo im zo.
Veamar rav chama bar gureya amar rav: halacha kerabbi shimon. uman pelig aleh — rabbi yehuda. veha amrat: rabbi yehuda verabbi shimon — halacha kerabbi yehuda. ella lav shema minna: letanhu?
Umay kusheya, dilma hecha deittemar — ittemar, hecha dela ittemar — la ittemar.

Ella, meha ditnan: ir shel yachid venaaset shel rabbim — mearvin et kullah. shel rabbim venaaset shel yachid — en mearvin et kullah ella im ken ose chutza lah, kair chadasha shebbihuda sheyyesh bah chamishshim dayorin — divre rabbi yehuda.
Rabbi shimon omer:

a: Shalosh chatzerot shel shene vattim. veamar rav chama bar gureya amar rav: halacha kerabbi shimon. uman pelig aleh — rabbi yehuda. veha amrat: rabbi yehuda verabbi shimon — halacha kerabbi yehuda!
Vmay kusheya? dilma hacha name, hecha deittemar — ittemar, hecha dela ittemar — la ittemar.
Ella, meha ditnan: hammanniach et beto vehalach lishbot beir acheret, echad nachri veechad yisrael — oser livne chatzerot, divre rabbi meir.

Rabbi yehuda omer: eno oser. rabbi yose omer: nachri — oser, yisrael — eno oser, mippene sheen derech yisrael lavo bashshabbat. rabbi shimon omer: afillu hinniach et beto vehalach lishbot etzel bitto beotah hair — eno oser, shekkevar hissiach dato.
Veamar rav chama bar gureya amar rav: halacha kerabbi shimon, uman pelig aleh — rabbi yehuda. veha amrat rabbi yehuda verabbi shimon halacha kerabbi yehuda!
Umay kusheya? dilma hacha name, hecha deittemar — ittemar, hecha dela ittemar — la ittemar.
Ella, meha ditnan: vezehu sheamru heani mearev beraglav. rabbi meir omer: anu en lanu ella ani.
Rabbi yehuda omer: echad ani veechad ashir. lo amru mearvin befat ella lehakel al heashir, shello yetze viarev beraglav.
Umatne leh rav chiyyay bar ashe lechiyyay bar rav kammeh derav: echad ani veechad ashir. vaamar leh rav, sayyem bah name: halacha kerabbi yehuda.
Tarte lema li, veha amrat: rabbi meir verabbi yehuda — halacha kerabbi yehuda!
Umay kusheya? dilma rav let leh lehane kelale?
Ella, meha ditnan: hayyevama lo tachalotz velo tityaybem ad sheyyehu lah shelosha chodashim.
Vechen shear kol hannashim lo yinnasu velo yitarsu ad sheyyehu lahen shelosha chodashim, echad betulot veechad beulot, echad almanot veechad gerushot, echad arusot veechad nesuot.
Rabbi yehuda omer: nesuot — yitarsu.
Vaarusot — yinnasu, chutz mearusa shebbihuda, mippene shellibbo gas bah.
Rabbi yose omer: kol hannashim yitarsu, chutz min haalmana — mippene haibbul.

Veamrinan: rabbi eliezer la al leve midresha. ashkecheh lerabbi assi dahava kaem. amar leh: may amur beve midresha? amar leh, hachi amar rabbi yochanan: halacha kerabbi yose. mikkelal dichidaa pelig aleh?

In, vehatanya: hare shehayta redufa lelech levet aviha, o shehayta lah kaas im balah, o shehaya balah zaken o chole, o shehayta hi chola, akara, zekena, ketanna veayylonit, vesheenah reuya leled, o shehaya balah chavush bevet haasurin, hammappelet leachar mitat balah — kullan tzerichin lehametin shelosha chodashim, divre rabbi meir. rabbi yose mattir leares velinnase miyyad.
Lema li? veha amrat rabbi meir verabbi yose — halacha kerabbi yose!
Umay kusheya? dilma leappoke midderav nachman amar shemuel, deamar: halacha kerabbi meir bigzerotav.
Ella, meha detanya: holchin leyarid shel nochrim velokchim mehen behema vaavadim ushefachot, battim sadot ucheramim, vechotev umaale bearkaot shellahen, mippene shehu kematztzil miyyadan.
Veim haya kohen — mittamme bechutza laaretz ladun ulearer immahen. ucheshem shemmittamme bechutza laaretz — kach mittamme bevet hakkevarot.
Bet hakkevarot salka datach?! tumea deorayyta hi!
Ella bevet happeras, derabbanan.
Umittamme lissa ishsha, velilmod tora. amar rabbi yehuda: ematay — bizman sheen motze lilmod, aval motze lilmod — lo yittamma.
Rabbi yose omer: af bizman shemmotze lilmod — name yittamma, lefi
b: Sheen min hakkol zoche adam lilmod. veamar rabbi yose: maase beyosef hakkohen shehalach etzel rabbo letzaydan lilmod tora.
Veamar rabbi yochanan: halacha kerabbi yose. ulema li? veha amrat rabbi yehuda verabbi yose — halacha kerabbi yose!
Amar abbaye: itzterich, salka datach amena: hane mille — bematnitin, aval bevarayyta — ema la. ka mashma lan
Ella hachi kaamar: hane kelale lav divre hakkol ninhu, deha rav let leh hane kelale.
Amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: cheftze nachri en konin shevita.
Leman, illema lerabbanan — peshita! hasheta cheftze hefker delet lehu bealim, en konin shevita. cheftze hannochri, deit lehu bealim, mibbaya?

Ella allibba derabbi yochanan ben nuri, veka mashma lan: emar deamar rabbi yochanan ben nuri konin shevita — hane mille cheftze hefker, delet lehu bealim. aval cheftze hannochri, deit lehu bealim — la.

Metivi, rabbi shimon ben elazar omer: hashshoel keli min hannochri beyom tov, vechen hammashil lo lannochri keli meerev yom tov vehechziro lo beyom tov, vehakkelim vehaotzarot sheshshavtu betoch hattechum — yesh lahen alpayim amma lechol ruach. venochri shehevi lo perot michutz lattechum — hare ze lo yezizem mimmekoman.
I amrat bishlama kasavar rabbi yochanan ben nuri cheftze nochri konin shevita, ha manni — rabbi yochanan ben nuri hi.
Ella i amrat kasavar rabbi yochanan ben nuri cheftze hannochri en konin shevita, ha manni — la rabbi yochanan ben nuri vela rabbanan!

Leolam kasavar rabbi yochanan ben nuri cheftze hannochri konin shevita, ushemuel deamar kerabbanan, udekaamrat: lerabbanan peshita — mahu detema: gezera bealim denochri attu bealim deyisrael, ka mashma lan.
Verav chiyyay bar avin amar rabbi yochanan: cheftze nochri konin shevita, gezera bealim denochri attu bealim deyisrael.
Hanhu dichre daato limvarachta, shera lehu rava livne machoza lemizban minnayyhu.
Amar leh ravina lerava: may dataych, deamar rav yehuda amar shemuel: cheftze nochri en konin shevita.
Veha shemuel verabbi yochanan — halacha kerabbi yochanan, veamar rav chiyyay bar avin amar rabbi yochanan: cheftze nochri konin shevita, gezera bealim denochri attu bealim deyisrael?!
Hadar amar rava: lizdabbenu livne mevarachta, dechulla mevarachta ledidhu kearba ammot damya.
Tane rabbi chiyyay: cherem shebben techume shabbat — tzarich

a: Mechitza shel barzel lehafesiko. mechayyech aleh rabbi yose berabbi chanina.
May tama ka mechayyech? illema mishshum detane la kerabbi yochanan ben nuri lechumera, veihu sevira leh kerabbanan lekulla. vmishshum desavar lekulla, man detane lechumera mechayyech ale?
Ella, mishshum detanya: neharot hammoshchin umayaynot hannovin — hare hen keragle kol adam.
Vedilma bimchunnasin.
Ella, mishshum dekatane: "tzarich mechitza shel barzel lehafesiko". umay shena kanim dela — deayyli behu mayya, shel barzel name — ayyli behu mayya.
Vedilma "tzarich veen lo takkana" kaamar.
Mishshum dekal hu shehekellu chachamim bemayim.
Kidrabbi tavla, diva minneh rabbi tavla merav: mechitza teluya, mahu shettattir bechureba?
Amar leh: en mechitza teluya matteret ella bemayim, kal hu shehekellu chachamim bemayim.
Vachachamim omrim en lo ella arba vechulei. rabbi yehuda hayeynu tanna kamma!
Amar rava: shemone al shemone ikka benayyhu. tanya name hachi: yesh lo shemone al shemone, divre rabbi meir.
Veamar rava: machaloket lehallech, aval letaltel divre hakkol: arba ammot — in, tefe — la.
Vehane arba ammot hecha ketiva?

Kidtanya: "shevu ish tachtav" — ketachtav. [vechamma tachtav] gufo shalosh ammot, veamma kede lifshot yadav veraglav — divre rabbi meir. rabbi yehuda omer: gufo shalosh ammot, veamma kede sheyyittol chefetz mittachat margelotav umanniach tachat meraashotav.
May benayyhu, ikka benayyhu: arba ammot metzumetzamot.
Amar leh rav mesharsheya livreh: ki ayylat lekammeh derav pappa, bei minneh: arba ammot sheamru, beamma dideh yahavinan leh, o beamma shel kodesh yahavinan leh?

Im amar lach: ammot shel kodesh yahavinan leh — og melech habbashan ma tehe alav? veim amar lach beamma dideh yahavinan leh, ema leh: may tama la katane la gabbe "yesh sheamru hakkol lefi ma shehu adam"?
Ki ata lekammeh derav pappa, amar leh: i dayykinan kulle hay, la have tanenan.
Leolam beamma dideh yahavinan leh. udeka kashya lach: may tama la katane gabbe "yesh sheamru"? — dela pesika leh, mishshum deikka nannas beevarav.
Hayu shenayim miktzat ammotav shel ze vechulei. lema leh lememar "lema haddavar dome"?
Hachi kaamar lehu rabbi shimon lerabbanan: mikkedi lema haddavar dome, leshalosh chatzerot happetuchot zo lazo, ufetuchot lirshut harabbim, may shena hatam difligitu, umay shena hacha dela peligitu?
Verabbanan: hatam avvshi dayorin. hacha la avvshi dayorin.
Ushetayim hachitzonot kulei. veammay? kevan dearvi lehu chitzonot bahade emtzait, havya lehu chada!
Amar rav yehuda: kegon shennatna emtzait eruvah bazo veeruvah bazo.
Verav sheshet amar: afillu tema shennatnu eruvan baemtzait, kegon shennetanuhu
b: Bishne vattim.
Keman? kevet shammay, detanya: chamishsha sheggavu et eruvan unetanuhu bishne chelim, bet shammay omrim: en eruvan eruv. uvet hillel omrim: eruvan eruv.
Afillu tema bet hillel, ad kan la kaamri bet hillel hatam — ella bishne chelim bevayit echad, aval bishne vattim, la.

Amar leh rav acha bereh derav avya lerav ashe: lerav yehuda kashya ulerav sheshet kashya. lerav yehuda kashya deamar: kegon shennatna emtzait eruvah bazo veeruvah bazo, vechevan deerva emtzait bahade chitzona havya leh chada, vechi hadra vearva bahade iddach — shelichutah avda.
Ulerav sheshet kashya: tehve kachamishsha sheshsheruyin bechatzer achat, veshachach echad mehen velo erav — deasri ahadade!

Amar leh rav ashe: la lerav yehuda kashya vela lerav sheshet kashya. lerav yehuda la kashya: kevan deerva la emtzait bahade chitzona, ushetayim chitzonot bahade hadade la ervu — galleya dateh divha nicha leh, uveha la nicha leh.
Ulerav sheshet la kashya: im amru dayorin lehakel, yomru dayorin lehachemir?!
Amar rav yehuda amar rav: zo divre rabbi shimon. aval chachamim omrim: reshut achat meshammeshet lishte reshuyot. aval la shete reshuyot meshammeshot lirshut achat.
Ki amrita kammeh dishmuel, amar li:

a: Af zo divre rabbi shimon, aval chachamim omrim: shelashtan asurot.

Tanya kevoteh derav yehuda allibba dishmuel, amar rabbi shimon: lema haddavar dome leshalosh chatzerot happetuchot zo lazo ufetuchot lirshut harabbim, ervu shetayim im haemtzait — zo mevia mittoch betah veochelet, vezo mevia mittoch betah veochelet. zo machzeret motarah letoch betah, vezo machzeret motarah letoch betah.
Aval chachamim omrim: shelashtan asurot.
Veazda shemuel letameh, deamar shemuel: chatzer shebben shene mevoot, erva im shenehem — asura im shenehem.
Lo erva im shenehem — oseret al shenehen.
Hayta beechad regila, uveechad enah regila, ze shergila bo — asur, veze sheenah regila bo — muttar.
Amar rabba bar rav huna: erva im sheenah regila bo — huttar regila leatzmo.
Veamar rabba bar rav huna amar shemuel: im erva regila leatzmo, veze sheenah regila bo lo erav, vehi atzmah lo erva — dochin otah etzel sheenah regila bo.
Uchegon ze kofin al middat sedom.
Amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: hammakpid al eruvo — en eruvo eruv. ma shemo — eruv shemo.
Rabbi chanina amar: eruvo eruv, ella shennikra meanshe vardina.
Amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: hacholek et eruvo — eno eruv.
Keman? kevet shammay, detanya: chamishsha sheggavu et eruvan unetanuhu bishne chelim, bet shammay omrim: en ze eruv, uvet hillel omrim: hare ze eruv!
Afillu tema bet hillel: ad kan la kaamri bet hillel hatam ella demalyayn lemana veiyyaytar, aval hecha defalgeh miflag — la.
Vetarte, lema li? tzerichi, dei ashmeinan hatam — mishshum dekafed. aval hacha — ema la.
Vei ashmeinan hacha — mishshum defalgeh miflag, aval hatam — ema la, tzericha.

Amar leh rabbi abba lerav yehuda beve matzarta deve rav zakkay: mi amar shemuel "hacholek et eruvo — eno eruv"? vehaamar shemuel: bayit shemmannichin bo eruv — eno tzarich litten et happat. may tama, lav mishshum deamar dechevan demannach besalla — keman demannach hacha dame? hachi name: kevan demannach besalla — keman demannach hacha dame!
Amar leh: hatam — af al pi sheen pat, may tama — dechullehu hacha dayyri.
Amar shemuel: eruv mishshum kinyan.
Veim tomar: mippene ma en konin bemaa — mippene sheenah metzuya bearve shabbatot.
Hecha deerav, mihu likne!
Gezera shemma yomru maa ikkar, vezimnin dela shechiach maa, vela ate leiarove befat, deate eruv leikalkole.
Rabba amar: eruv mishshum dira.
May benayyhu? ikka benayyhu: keli,
Ufachot mishshave peruta,
b: Vekatan.

Amar leh abbaye lerabba: ledidach kashya velishmuel kashya. ha tanya: chamishsha sheggavu et eruvan, keshehem molichin et eruvan lemakom acher — echad molich lechullan. hu nihu deka kane, vetu la. hu nihu deka dayayr, vetu la!
Amar leh: la ledidi kashya, vela lishmuel kashya, shelichut dechullehu ka aved.
Amar rabba amar rav chama bar gureya amar rav: halacha kerabbi shimon.
Mishna mi shebba bederech vechashcha lo, vehaya makkir ilan o gader, veamar: "shevitati tachtav" — lo amar kelum.
"Shevitati beikkaro" — mehallech mimmekom raglav vead ikkaro alpayim amma, umeikkaro vead beto alpayim amma. nimtza mehallech mishshechashecha arbaat alafim amma.
Im eno makkir, o sheeno baki bahalacha, veamar "shevitati bimkomi" — zacha lo mekomo alpayim amma lechol ruach.
Agullot, divre rabbi chanina ben antignos, vachachamim omrim: merubbaot, ketavla merubbaat, kede sheyyihye niskar lazzaviyyot.
Vezo hi sheamru: heani mearev beraglav. amar rabbi meir: anu en lanu ella ani. rabbi yehuda omer: echad ani veechad ashir, lo amru mearvin befat ella lehakel al heashir, shello yetze viarev beraglav.
Gemara may "lo amar kelum"?
Amar rav: lo amar kelum kol ikkar, daafillu letachtav shel ilan la matze azel.
Ushemuel amar: lo amar kelum leveto, aval letachtav shel ilan matze azel.
Venaase tachtav shel ilan chammar gammal.
Ba limdod min hatztzafon — moddin lo min haddarom, ba limdod min haddarom — moddin lo min hatztzafon.

a: Amar rabba: may tama derav — mishshum dela mesayyaym atreh.
Veikka deamri, amar rabba: may tama derav — mishshum dekasavar: kol sheeno beze achar ze — afillu bevat achat eno.
May benayyhu? ikka benayyhu deamar: "likno li bearba ammot miggo shemone".
Man deamar mishshum dela mesayyaym atreh — ha la mesayyaym atreh.
Uman deamar mishshum "kol sheeno beze achar ze afillu bevat achat eno" — hay kearba ammot dame, dehacha arba ammot kaamar.
Gufa, amar rabba: kol davar sheeno beze achar ze — afillu bevat achat eno, etiveh abbaye lerabba: hammarbe bemaasrot — perotav metukkanin, umaserotav mekulekalin.
Ammay? lema: kol sheeno beze achar ze — afillu bevat achat eno!
Shane maaser deiteh lachatzain, dei amar: "tikdosh palga palga dechitteta" — kadsha.
Masar behema deleteh lachatzain.
Veamar (rabba): yatzu shenayim baasiri, ukeraan asiri — asiri veachad asar meoravin ze baze!
Shane masar behema deiteh beze achar ze betaut.
Ditnan: kara latteshii asiri, velaasiri teshii, velaachad asar asiri — shelashtan mekuddashin.

Vahare toda, deleta betaut, veleta beze achar ze, veittemar: toda shennishchata al shemonim challot, chizkiyya amar: kadshu ala arbaim mittoch shemonim, rabbi yochanan amar: lo kadshu ala arbaim mittoch shemonim.
Ha ittemar ala, amar rabbi (zera): hakkol modim hecha deamar "likdeshu arbaim mittoch shemonim" — dekadshi, "lo yikdeshu arbaim ella im ken kadshu shemonim" — kulle alma la peligi delo kadshu.
Ki peligi bistama. mar savar: leachrayut ka mechavven, veal tenay ayytinhu.
b: Umar savar: lekorban gadol ka mechavven.
Amar abbaye: lo shanu ella beilan shettachtav shetem esre amma, aval beilan sheen shetem esre amma, hare miktzat beto nikkar.
Matkef la rav huna bereh derav yehoshua: mimmay divarbei metziata ka mesayyaym, dilma bearbei dehay gisa uvearbei dehay gisa kamsayyaym!
Ella amar rav huna bereh derav yehoshua: lo shanu ella beilan shettachtav shemone ammot, aval beilan shettachtav sheva ammot — hare miktzat beto nikkar.
Tanya kevoteh derav, tanya kevoteh dishmuel.

Tanya kevoteh derav: mi shebba badderech vechashcha lo, vehaya makkir ilan o gader, veamar: "shevitati tachtav" — lo amar kelum. aval im amar: "shevitati bemakom peloni" — mehallech ad shemmaggia leoto makom. higgia leoto makom — mehallech et kullo vechutza lo alpayim amma.
Bamme devarim amurim — bemakom hamesuyyaym, kegon sheshshavat betel shehu gavoah asara tefachim, vehu mearba ammot vead bet satayim.
Vechen bika shehi amukka asara, vehi mearba ammot vead bet satayim. aval bemakom sheen mesuyyaym — en lo ella arba ammot.
Hayu shenayim, echad makkir veechad sheeno makkir — ze sheeno makkir moser shevitato lammakkir, vehammakkir omer: "shevitati bemakom peloni".
Bamme devarim amurim — keshessiyyem arba ammot shekkava. aval lo siyyem arba ammot shekkava — lo yazuz mimmekomo.

Lema tehve teyuveteh dishmuel? amar lach shemuel: hacha bemay askinan, kegon deikka mimmekom raglav vead ikkaro tere alfe vearba garmide, dei mokmet leh beiddach gisa deilan — kam leh levar mittechuma.
I sayyem arba ammot — matze azel, vei la — la matze azel.

Tanya kevoteh dishmuel: taa veerav lishte ruchot, kimdumme hu shemmearvin lo lishte ruchot, o sheamar laavadav "tzeu vearvu li", echad erav alav latztzafon veechad erav alav laddarom — mehallech latztzafon keeruvo laddarom, veladdarom keeruvo latztzafon.
Veim mitztzeu alav et hattechum — lo yazuz mimmekomo.
Lema tehve teyuveteh derav? rav tanna hu ufaleg.
Amar shevitati beikkaro — mehallech mimmekom raglav vead ikkaro alpayim amma, umeikkaro leveto alpayim amma. nimtza mehallech mishshechashecha arbaat alafim amma.

a: Amar rava: vehu dechi rahet leikkaro mate. amar leh abbaye: veha "chashcha lo" katane!
"Chashcha" — leveto, aval leikkaro shel ilan matze azel. ikka deamri amar rava: chashcha lo ki mesagge kalli kalli, aval rahet — mate.
Rabba verav yosef havo ka azli beorcha. amar leh rabba lerav yosef: tehe shevitatenu tute dikla desavel achu. veamri la: tute dikla defarek mareh mikkeraga.

Yada leh mar? amar leh: la yadana leh. amar leh: semoch alay, detanya, rabbi yose omer: im hayu shenayim, echad makkir veechad sheeno makkir — ze sheeno makkir moser shevitato lammakkir, ze shemmakkir omer: tehe "shevitatenu bemakom peloni".
Vela hi, la tena leh kerabbi yose, ella ki hechi delikabbel la minneh, mishshum derabbi yose nimmuko immo.
Im eno makkir o sheeno baki vechulei.
Hane alpayim amma hechan ketivan? detanya: "shevu ish tachtav" — ellu arba ammot. "al yetze ish mimmekomo" — ellu alpayim amma.

Mena lan? amar rav chisda: lamadnu 'makom mimmakom, umakom minnisa, venissa minnisa, venissa miggevul, ugevul miggevul, ugevul michutz, vechutz michutz. dichtiv: "umaddotem michutz lair et peat kedma alpayim baamma vegomer".
Venelaf mikkir hair vachutza elef amma"? danin 'chutz michutz, veen danin 'chutz mechutza.
Umay nafka minna? ha tana deve rabbi yishmael: "veshav hakkohen" "uva hakkohen" — zo hi shiva, zo hi bia!
Hane mille hecha delekka midde dedame leh, aval hecha deikka midde dedame leh — middame leh yalfinan.
Alpayim amma agullot. verabbi chanina ben antignos ma nafshach: i it leh gezera shava — peot ketivan, i let leh gezera shava — alpayim amma mena leh?
Leolam it leh gezera shava, veshane hacha deamar kera: "ze yihye lahem migreshe hearim" — laze atta noten peot, vei atta noten peot leshovte shabbat.
Verabbanan? tane, rav chananya omer: kaze yehu kol shovte shabbat.
Amar rabbi acha bar yaakov: hammaavir arba ammot birshut harabbim eno chayyayv ad shemmaavir hen vaalachsonan.

Amar rav pappa badek lan rava: ammud birshut harabbim gavoah asara verochav arbaa, tzarich hen vaalachsonan o la? veamrinan leh: lav hayeynu derav chananya? detanya, rav chananya omer: kaze yehu kol shovte shabbat.
Veze hu sheamru heani mearev beraglav. amar rabbi meir: anu en lanu ella ani vechulei.
Amar rav nachman: machaloket "bimkomi", derabbi meir savar: ikkar eruv befat,
b: Ani hu deakkilu rabbanan illaveh, aval ashir — la.
Verabbi yehuda savar: ikkar eruv baregel, echad ani veechad ashir. aval "bemakom peloni" — divre hakkol: ane — in, ashir — la.
"Vezo hi sheamru" man katane la — rabbi meir. veaheyay kae — aeno makkir o sheeno baki bahalacha". "velo amru mearvin befat ella lehakel" man katane la — rabbi yehuda.

Verav chisda amar: machaloket "bemakom peloni", derabbi meir savar: ani — in, ashir — la, verabbi yehuda savar: echad ani veechad ashir. aval "bimkomi", divre hakkol echad ani veechad ashir, deikkar eruv baregel.
"Vezo hi sheamru" man katane la — rabbi meir. veaheyay kae — aha: "mi shebba badderech vechashecha". "velo amru mearvin befat ella lehakel" man katane la — divre hakkol.

Tanya kevoteh derav nachman: echad ani veechad ashir mearvin befat, velo yetze ashir chutz lattechum veyomar: "shevitati bimkomi" — lefi shello amru mearvin baregel ella lemi shebba badderech vechashecha, divre rabbi meir.

Rabbi yehuda omer: echad ani veechad ashir mearvin baregel, veyetze ashir chutz lattechum: veyomar "tehe shevitati bimkomi", veze hu ikkaro shel eruv. vehittiru chachamim levaal habbayit leshalleach eruvo beyad avdo, beyad beno, beyad shelucho bishvil lehakel alav.

Amar rabbi yehuda: maase beanshe bet memel uveanshe bet gureyon bearoma shehayu mechallekin gerogrot vetzimmukin laaniyyim bishne vatztzoret, uvain aniyye kefar shichin vaaniyye kefar chananya umachshichin al hattechum, lammochorat mashkimin uvain.
Amar rav ashe: matnitin name dayka, dekatane: mi sheyyatza lelech leir shemmearvin lah, vehechziro chavero — hu muttar lelech, vechol bene hair asurin, divre rabbi yehuda.
Vahavenan ba: may shena ihu umay shena inhu? veamar rav huna: hacha bemay askinan — kegon sheyyesh lo shene vattim, ushene techume shabbat benehen.
Ihu, kevan denafka leh leorcha — hava leh ani.
Vehanach — ashirim ninhu. alma kol "bemakom peloni" — ani in, ashir la. shema minna.
Matne leh rav chiyyay bar ashe lechiyyay bar rav kammeh derav "echad ani veechad ashir". amar leh rav: sayyem bah name halacha kerabbi yehuda.
Rabba bar rav chanan hava regil deate meartivna lefumebdita.

a: Amar: "tehe shevitati betzinta". amar leh abbaye: may dataych, rabbi meir verabbi yehuda — halacha kerabbi yehuda, veamar rav chisda: machaloket bemakom peloni",
Veha rav nachman, vetanya kevoteh! amar leh: hadari bi.
Amar rame bar chama: hare amru shavat yesh lo arba ammot. hannoten et eruvo, yesh lo arba ammot, o la?
Amar rava, ta shema: lo amru mearvin befat ella lehakel al heashir, shello yetze viarev beraglav. vei amrat en lo — hay lehakel?! lehachamir hu!
Afillu hachi nicha leh, ki hechi dela nitrach venippok.
Mishna mi sheyyatza lelech beir shemmearvin bah, vehechziro chavero — hu muttar lelech, vechol bene hair asurin, divre rabbi yehuda.
Rabbi meir omer: kol shehu yachol learev velo erav — hare ze chammar gammal.
Gemara may shena ihu umay shena inhu? amar rav huna: hacha bemay askinan — kegon sheyyesh lo shene vattim, uvenehen shene techume shabbat.
Ihu, kevan dinfak leh leorcha — have leh ani. vehane ashire ninhu.
Tanya name hachi: mi sheyyesh lo shene vattim, uvenehen shene techume shabbat, kevan shehechzik badderech — kana eruv, divre rabbi yehuda.
Yater al ken amar rabbi yose berabbi yehuda: afillu metzao chavero veamar lo: "lin po, et chamma hu, et tzinna hu" — lemachar mashkim veholech.
Amar rabba: lomar — kulle alma la peligi ditzrich, ki peligi — lehachezik.
Verav yosef amar: lehachezik — dechulle alma la peligi ditzrich, ki peligi — lomar.
Keman azla ha deamar ulla: mi shehechzik badderech vehechziro chavero — hare hu muchezar umuchezak.
I muchezar, lamma muchezak? vei muchezak, lamma muchezar?
Hachi kaamar: af al pi shemmuchezar — muchezak. keman — kerav yosef, veallibba derabbi yose berabbi yehuda.
Rav yehuda bar ishtata ayyti leh kalkalla defere lerav natan bar oshaya. ki hava azel, shavkeh ad dinchet darga, amar leh: bit hacha. limchar kaddem veezil,
b: Keman — kerav yosef, veallibba derabbi yose bar yehuda?
La, kerabba, veallibba derabbi yehuda.
Rabbi meir omer kol sheyyachol learev kulei. ha tenena chada zimna: safek, rabbi meir verabbi yehuda omrim: hare ze chammar gammal.
Amar rav sheshet la tema tama derabbi meir safek erav safek lo erav hu dehave chammar gammal, aval vadday lo erav — la have chammar gammal.
Ella: afillu vadday lo erav have chammar gammal. deha hacha vadday lo erav, veka have chammar gammal.
Mishna mi sheyyatza chutz lattechum afillu amma achat lo yikkanes. rabbi eliezer omer: shetayim — yikkanes, shalosh — lo yikkanes.
Gemara amar rabbi chanina: raglo achat betoch hattechum, veraglo achat chutz lattechum — lo yikkanes, dichtiv: "im tashiv mishshabbat raglecha". "raglecha" ketiv.
Vehatanya: raglo achat betoch hattechum veraglo achat chutz lattechum — yikkanes! ha manni? acherim hi, detanya: acherim omrim: limkom sherubbo hu nizkar.
Ikka deamri, amar rabbi chanina: raglo achat betoch hattechum veraglo achat chutz lattechum — yikkanes, dichtiv: "im tashiv mishshabbat raglecha" — "raglecha" karenan.
Vehattanya: lo yikkanes! hu deamar kaacherim, detanya: limkom sherubbo hu nizkar.

Rabbi eliezer omer shetayim yikkanes shalosh lo yikkanes. vehatanya, rabbi eliezer omer: achat — yikkanes, shetayim — lo yikkanes. la kashya: ha daakar chada vekam attarte. ha daakar tarte vekam attelat.
Vehatanya, rabbi eliezer omer: afillu amma achat lo yikkanes! ki tanya hahi lemoded, ditnan: velammoded sheamru notnin lo alpayim amma — afillu sof middato kale bimara.
Mishna mi shehecheshich chutz lattechum afillu amma achat lo yikkanes. rabbi shimon omer: afillu chamesh esre ammot yikkanes, sheen hammashochot mematztzin et hammiddot mippene hattoin.
Gemara tana: mippene toe hammidda.
Haderan alach mi shehotziuhu
Mishna ketzad meabberin et hearim? bayit nichnas bayit yotze, piggum nichnas piggum yotze, hayu sham gedudiyyot gevohot asara tefachim,

a: Ugesharim unefashot sheyyesh bahen bet dira — motziin et hammidda kenegdan. veosin otah kemin tavla merubbaat, kede sheyyehe niskar et hazzaviyyot.
Gemara rav ushemuel: chad tane "meabberin" vechad tane "meabberin".
Man detane "meabberin" — ever ever, uman detane "meabberin" — keishsha ubbarah.
Mearat hammachpela, rav ushemuel, chad amar: shene vattim ze lifnim mizze, vechad amar: bayit vaaliyyay al gabbav.
Bishlama leman deamar ze al gav ze — hayeynu "machpela". ella leman deamar shene vattim ze lifnim mizze, may "machpela"?
Shekkefula bezugot. "mamre kiryat arba", amar rabbi yitzchak, kiryat haarba zugot: adam vechavva, avraham vesara, yitzchak verivka, yaakov velea.

"Vayhi bime amrafel", rav ushemuel, chad amar: nimrod shemo. velamma nikra shemo amrafel? sheamar vehippil leavraham avinu betoch kivshan haesh, vechad amar: amrafel shemo, velamma nikra shemo nimrod? shehimrid et kol haolam kullo alav bemalchuto.
"Vayyakom melech chadash al mitzrayim", rav ushemuel, chad amar: chadash mammash, vechad amar: shennitchaddeshu gezerotav.
Man deamar chadash mammash — dichtiv "chadash", uman deamar shennitchaddeshu gezerotav — middela ketiv "vayyamot vayyimloch".
Uleman deamar shennitchaddeshu gezerotav, ha chetiv "asher lo yada et yosef"? may "asher lo yada et yosef" — dahava dame keman dela yada leh leyosef kelal.
(Siman: shemone esre ushenem asar lamadnu bedavid vayyiven.)
Amar rabbi yochanan: shemona asar yamim giddalti etzel rabbi oshaya beribbi velo lamadti mimmennu ella davar echad bemishnatenu: ketzad meabberin et hearim — bealef.
Ini?! vehaamar rabbi yochanan shenem asar talmidim hayu lo lerabbi oshaya beribbi, ushemona asar yamim giddalti benehen, velamadti lev kol echad veechad, vechochmat kol echad veechad?
Lev kol echad veechad vechochmat kol echad veechad gemar, gemara — la gemar. ibbaet ema: minnayyhu didhu — gemar, minneh dideh — la gemar. veibbaet ema: davar echad bemishnatenu kaamar.

Veamar rabbi yochanan: keshehayinu lomdin tora etzel rabbi oshaya, hayinu yoshvin arbaa arbaa beamma. amar rabbi: keshehayinu lomdin tora etzel rabbi elazar ben shammua, hayinu yoshvin shishsha shishsha beamma.
Amar rabbi yochanan: rabbi oshaya beribbi bedoro kerabbi meir bedoro, ma rabbi meir bedoro lo yachlu chaverav laamod al sof dato — af rabbi oshaya lo yachlu chaverav laamod al sof dato.
Amar rabbi yochanan: libban shel rishonim kefitcho shel ulam, veshel acharonim kefitcho shel hechol, veanu — kimlo nekev machat sidkit.
Rishonim — rabbi akiva, acharonim — rabbi elazar ben shammua. ikka deamri: rishonim — rabbi elazar ben shammua, acharonim — rabbi oshaya beribbi. veanu kimlo nekev machat sidkit.
Amar abbaye: vaanan, ki sikketa begudda ligmara. amar rava: vaanan, ki etzbata bekira lisvara. amar rav ashe: anan, ki etzbata bevera leshichcha.
Amar rav yehuda amar rav: bene yehuda shehikpidu al leshonam, nitkayyeyma toratam beyadam. bene galil shello hikpidu al leshonam, lo nitkayyeyma toratam beyadam.

Midde bikfeda talya milleta? ella: bene yehuda dedayyki lishshana, umatnechi lehu simana, nitkayyeyma toratan beyadan. bene galil dela dayyki lishshana, vela matnechi lehu simana, lo nitkayyeyma toratan beyadam.
Bene yehuda gemaru mechad rabba, nitkayyeyma toratan beyadam. bene galil dela gamri mechad rabba, lo nitkayyeyma toratan beyadam.
Ravina amar: bene yehuda degallo massechta, nitkayyeyma toratan beyadam. bene galil dela gallo massechta, lo nitkayyeyma toratan beyadam.
David galli massechta, shaul la galli massechta. david degalli massechta, ketiv beh: "yereecha yiruni veyismachu". shaul dela galli massechta, ketiv beh: "(el kol) asher yifne
b: Yarshia".
Veamar rabbi yochanan: minnayin shemmachal lo hakkadosh baruch hu al oto avon — shenneemar: "machar atta uvanecha immi". immi — bimchitzati.
Amar rabbi abba: i ikka dimshael lehu livne yehuda dedayyki lishshane — meabberin tenan o meabberin tenan, akkuzo tenan o akkuzo tenan, yadi.
Sheelinhu veamri leh: ikka detane meabberin, veikka detane meabberin. ikka detane akkuzo veikka detane akkuzo.
Bene yehuda dayyki lishshana may hi? dehahu bar yehuda daamar lehu: tallit yesh li limkor. amaru leh: may goon tallitcha? amar lehu: kitradin ale adama.

Bene galil dela dayyki lishshana may hi? (detanya) dehahu bar galila [dahava kaazel] vaamar lehu: "amar leman, amar leman?" amaru leh: galilaa shote, chamar lemirkav o chamar lemishte? amar lemilbash o immar leitkassaa?
Hahi itteta devaaya lememar lachaverta: "tai deochlich chalava", amara la: "sheluchati, tochlicha lavi".
Hahi itteta deatya lekammeh dedayyayna, amara leh: "mari kiri, tafla havayt li veganvuch min. vechaddu havot, dechad shadru lach illavay — la mate karaych aara".
Amhata deve rabbi ki hava mishtaya bilshon chochma, amra hachi: elet nekafat bechad, yidon nishrayya lekinnehon.
Vechad hava bae delittevun, hava amra lehu: yide batar chaverta minna, vetitkefe elet bechad, keilfa deazla beyamma.
Rabbi yose bar asyayn ki hava mishtae bilshon chochma, amar: asu li shor bemishpat betur misken.
Vechad hava shael beushepiza, amar hachi: gevar pum den chay, ma zo tova yesh?
Rabbi avahu ki hava mishtae bilshon chochma, hava amar hachi: atrigu lefechamin, arkiu lizhavin, vaasu li shene maggide baalata. ikka deamri: veyaasu li bahen shene maggide baalata.
Amaru leh rabbanan lerabbi avahu: hatzepinenu hechan rabbi ilay tzafun. amar lahen: alatz benaara aharonit acharonit eranit vehinirattu.
Amri la ishsha.
Veamri la massechta.
Amri leh lerabbi ilay: hatzepinenu hechan rabbi avahu [tzafun]. amar lahen: nityayetz bammachtir vehingiv limfivoshet.

Amar rabbi yehoshua ben chananya: miyyamay lo nitztzechani adam chutz meishsha tinok vetinoket. ishsha may hi? paam achat nitarachti etzel achsanya achat, asta li polin beyom rishon — achaltim velo shiyyayrti mehen kelum. sheniyyay, velo shiyyayrti mehen kelum. beyom shelishi hikdichatan bemelach, kevan shettaamti — mashachti yaday mehen.
Amra li: rabbi, mippene ma encha soed? amarti lah: kevar saadti mibbeod yom. amra li: haya lecha limshoch yadecha min happat!
Amra li: rabbi, shemma lo hinnachta pea barishonim? velo kach amru chachamim: en meshayyeyrin pea bailpas, aval meshayyeyrin pea bakkeara.

Tinoket may hi? paam achat hayiti mehallech badderech, vehayta derech overet bassade, vehayiti mehallech bah. amra li tinoket achat: rabbi, lo sade hi zo? amarti lah: lo, derech kevusha hi. amra li: listim kemotcha kevashuha.

Tinok may hi? paam achat hayiti mehallech badderech, veraiti tinok yoshev al parashat derachim. veamarti lo: beeze derech nelech lair? amar li: zo ketzara vaarukka, vezo arukka uketzara. vehalachti biktzara vaarukka, kevan shehiggati lair matzati shemmakkifin otah gannot ufardesin.

Chazarti laachoray. amarti lo: beni, halo amarta li ketzara? amar li: velo amarti lecha arukka? neshaktiv al rosho, veamarti lo: ashrechem yisrael shekkullechem chachamim gedolim attem, miggedolchem vead ketannechem.

Rabbi yose haggelili hava ka azel beorcha, ashkecha livrureya amar la: beezo derech nelech lelod? amara leh: galili shote, lo kach amru chachamim: al tarbe sicha im haishsha?! haya lecha lomar: "beeze lelod".
Berureya ashkachteh lehahu talmida dahava ka gares bilchisha.

a: Betasha beh, amara leh: lo kach katuv "arucha vakkol ushemura", im arucha birmach evarim shellecha — mishtammeret, veim lav — enah mishtammeret. tana: talmid echad haya lerabbi eliezer shehaya shone belachash, leachar shalosh shanim shachach talmudo.
Tana, talmid echad haya lo lerabbi eliezer shennitchayyev bisrefa lammakom. amru: hannichu lo adam gadol shimmesh.

Amar leh shemuel lerav yehuda: shinnana, petach pummaych keri, petach pummaych teni, ki hechi detitkayyaym baych vetorich chayye, shenneemar: "ki chayyim hem lemotzehem ulechol besaro marpe", al tikre "lemotzehem" ella "lemotziehem bappe".
Amar leh shemuel lerav yehuda: shinnana, chatof veechol chatof veishti, dealma deazlinan minneh kehillula dame.

Amar leh rav lerav hamenuna: beni im yesh lach — hetev lach, sheen bashsheol taanug, veen lammavet hitmahmeah. veim tomar anniach levanay — chok bashsheol mi yaggid lach: bene haadam domim leisve hassade hallalu notztzin vehallalu novlin.
Amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: hamehallech badderech veen immo levayay — yaasok battora, shenneemar: "ki livyat chen hem".

Chash berosho — yaasok betora, shenneemar: "ki livyat chen hem leroshecha". chash bigrono — yaasok battora, shenneemar: "vaanakim legargerotecha". chash bemeav — yaasok battora, shenneemar: "rifut tehi lesharecha". chash beatzmotav — yaasok battora, shenneemar: "veshikkuy leatzmotecha". chash bechol gufo — yaasok battora, shenneemar: "ulechol besaro marpe".

Amar rav yehuda berabbi chiyyay: bo uree, shello kemiddat hakkadosh baruch hu middat basar vedam. middat basar vadam: adam noten sam lachavero — laze yafe, velaze kashe. aval hakkadosh baruch hu eno ken: natan tora leyisrael — sam chayyim lechol gufo, shenneemar: "ulechol besaro marpe".

Amar rav amme: may dichtiv "ki naim ki tishmerem bevitnecha yikkonu yachdav al sefatecha", ematay divre tora neimim — bizman shettishmerem bevitnecha, veematay tishmerem bevitnecha — bizman sheyyikkonu yachdav al sefatecha.

Rabbi zera amar mehacha: "simcha laish bemaane fiv vedavar beitto ma tov", ematay simcha laish — bizman shemmaane befiv. lashon acher: ematay simcha laish bemaane fiv — bizman sheddavar beitto ma tov.
Rabbi yitzchak amar mehacha: "ki karov elecha haddavar meod beficha uvilvavcha laasoto", ematay karov elecha — bizman shebbeficha uvilvavcha laasoto.
Rava amar mehacha: "taavat libbo natatta lo vaareshet sefatav bal manata sela", ematay taavat libbo natatta lo — bizman sheareshet sefatav bal manata sela.
Rava rame: ketiv "taavat libbo natatta lo". uchetiv "vaareshet sefatav bal manata sela". zacha — taavat libbo natatta lo. lo zacha — vaareshet sefatav bal manata sela.
Tana deve rabbi eliezer ben yaakov: kol makom shenneemar "netzach" "sela" "vaed" — en lo hefsek olamit. netzach, dichtiv: "ki lo leolam ariv velo lanetzach ekketzof".
Sela, dichtiv: "kaasher shamanu ken rainu beir Adonai tzevaot beir elohenu elohim yechonneha ad olam sela". vaed, dichtiv: "Adonai yimloch leolam vaed".

(Siman: "anakim" "lechayav" "luchot" "charut"). amar rabbi (eliezer): may dichtiv "vaanakim legargerotecha", im mesim adam atzmo kaanak ze sheraf al hatztzavvar venire veeno nire — talmudo mitkayyem beyado. veim lav — en talmudo mitkayyem beyado.

Veamar rabbi eliezer: may dichtiv "lechayav kaarugat habbosem", im mesim adam atzmo kaaruga zo shehakkol dashin bah, uchevosem ze shehakkol mitbassemin bah — talmudo mitkayyem, veim lav — en talmudo mitkayyem.
Veamar rabbi (eliezer): may dichtiv "luchot even", im adam mesim atzmo et lechayav keeven zo sheenah nimchet — talmudo mitkayyem beyado, veim lav — en talmudo mitkayyem beyado.
Veamar rabbi (eliezer): may dichtiv "charut al halluchot", ilmale lo nishtabberu luchot harishonot — lo nishtakkecha tora miyyisrael.
Rav acha bar yaakov amar: en kol umma velashon sholetet bahen, shenneemar: "charut" — al tikre "charut", ella cherut.
Amar rav matna: may dichtiv "umimmidbar mattana", im mesim adam atzmo kemidbar ze shehakkol dashin bo — talmudo mitkayyem beyado. veim lav — en talmudo mitkayyem beyado.

Rava bereh derav yosef bar chama hava leh milleta lerav yosef bahadeh, ki meta maale yoma dechippure amar: ezil vaafayyeyseh. azal, ashkecheh leshammaeh deka mazeg leh kasa. amar: hav li veemzegeh ana. yehav leh, mazgeh. kidtameh amar: dame hay meziga limziga derava bereh derav yosef bar chama. amar leh: ana hu.
Amar leh: la tittev akkaraycha ad dimfarshat li hane kerae. may dichtiv: "umimmidbar mattana umimmattana nachaliel uminnachaliel bamot umibbamot haggay"?

Amar leh: im adam mesim atzmo kemidbar ze shehakkol dashin bo — tora nittena lo bemattana. vechevan shennittena lo bemattana — nechalo el, shenneemar: "umimmattana nachaliel". vechevan shennechalo el — ole ligdulla, shenneemar: "uminnachaliel bamot".
Veim meges libbo — hakkadosh baruch hu mashpilo, shenneemar: "umibbamot haggay". veim chozer bo — hakkadosh baruch hu magbiho, shenneemar: "kol ge yinnase".

Amar rav huna: may dichtiv: "chayyatcha yashvu vah tachin betovatcha leani elohim", im adam mesim atzmo kechayya zo sheddoreset veochelet, veikka deamri shemmasrachat veochelet — talmudo mitkayyem beyado. veim lav — en talmudo mitkayyem beyado. veim ose ken — hakkadosh baruch hu ose lo seuda beatzmo, shenneemar: "tachin betovatcha leani elohim".
Amar rabbi chiyyay bar abba amar rabbi yochanan: may dichtiv "notzer teena yochal piryah", lamma nimshelu divre tora kitena, ma teena zo
b: Kol zeman sheadam memashmesh bah — motze bah teenim. af divre tora, kol zeman sheadam hoge bahen — motze bahen taam.

Amar rabbi shemuel bar nachmani: may dichtiv "ayyelet ahavim veyaalat chen vegomer", lamma nimshelu divre tora leayyelet? lomar lach: ma ayyala rachmah tzar, vachaviva al boalah kol shaa veshaa keshaa rishona — af divre tora chavivin al lomdehen kol shaa veshaa keshaa rishona.

"Veyaalat chen" — shemmaalat chen al lomdeha. "daddeha yeravvucha vechol et" — lamma nimshelu divre tora kedad? ma dad ze kol zeman shehattinok memashmesh bo — motze bo chalav, af divre tora, kol zeman sheadam hoge bahen — motze bahen taam.

"Beahavatah tishge tamid" — kegon rabbi (eliezer) ben pedat. amru alav al rabbi (eliezer) shehaya yoshev veosek battora bashshuk hattachton shel tzippori, usedino mutal bashshuk haelyon shel tzippori. (tanya) amar rabbi yitzchak ben elazar: paam achat ba adam littelo, umatza bo saraf.

Tana deve rav anan: may dichtiv "rochve atonot tzechorot yoshve al middin [veholche al derech sichu]", "rochvay atonot" — ellu talmide chachamim, shemmehallechin meir leir umimmedina limdina lilmod (bo) tora. "tzechorot" — sheosin otah ketzohorayim. "yoshve al middin" — sheddanin din emet laamitto. "veholche" — ellu baale mikra. "al derech" — ellu baale mishna. "sichu" — ellu baale talmud, shekkol sichatan divre tora.
Amar rav shezvi mishshum rabbi elazar ben azarya: may dichtiv "lo yacharoch remiyya tzedo" — lo yichye velo yaarich yamim tzayyayd harammay.
Rav sheshet amar: tzayyayd harammay yacharoch?
Ki ata rav dimi, amar: mashal letzayyayd shetztzad tzipporim, im rishon rishon meshabber kenafav — mishtammer, veim lav — en mishtammer.
Amar (rabba) amar rav sechora amar rav huna: may dichtiv "hon mehevel yimat vekovetz al yad yarbe", im ose adam torato chavilot chavilot, — mitmaet, veim lav — kovetz al yad yarbe.
Amar rabba: yadi rabbanan leha milleta, veavri ala. amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: ana avadta, veikkayyaym biday.

Tanu rabbanan, ketzad seder mishna: moshe lamad mippi haggevura. nichnas aharon, veshana lo moshe pirko, nistallek aharon veyashav lismol moshe. nichnesu banav, veshana lahen moshe pirkan. nistalleku banav, elazar yashav limin moshe, veitamar lismol aharon. rabbi yehuda omer: leolam aharon limin moshe chozer. nichnesu zekenim veshana lahen moshe pirkan. nistalleku zekenim, nichnesu kol haam veshana lahen moshe pirkan. nimtzeu beyad aharon arbaa, beyad banav shelosha, uveyad hazzekenim shenayim, uveyad kol haam echad.
Nistallek moshe veshana lahen aharon pirko. nistallek aharon shanu lahen banav pirkan. nistalleku banav, shanu lahen zekenim pirkan. nimtza beyad hakkol arbaa.

Mikkan amar rabbi eliezer: chayyayv adam lishnot letalmido arbaa peamim. vekal vachomer, uma aharon shellamad mippi moshe, umoshe mippi haggevura — kach, hedyot mippi hedyot — al achat kamma vechamma.
Rabbi akiva omer: minnayin shechayyayv adam lishnot letalmido ad sheyyilmadennu — shenneemar: "velammedah et bene yisrael", uminnayin ad shettehe sedura befihem — shenneemar: "simah befihem",
Uminnayin shechayyayv lehareot lo panim — shenneemar: "veelle hammishpatim asher tasim lifnehem".
Veligmeru kullehu mimmoshe! kede lachalok kavod leaharon uvanav, vechavod lazzekenim.

Veneul aharon venigmar mimmoshe, veliayylu banav veligmeru meaharon, veliayylu zekenim velelfu mibbanav, velezlu velaygmerinhu lechullehu yisrael! kevan demoshe mippi haggevura gamar, mistayyeya milleteh.

Amar mar, rabbi yehuda omer: leolam aharon limin moshe chozer. keman azla ha detanya: shelosha shehayu mehallechin badderech — harav baemtza, vegadol bimino, vekatan bismolo. lema rabbi yehuda hi vela rabbanan?
Afillu tema rabbanan, mishshum tircha deaharon.
Rabbi perida hava leh hahu talmida dahava tane leh arba mea zimne vegamar. yoma chad bayu lemilleta demitzva. tena leh vela gemar.

Amar leh: haiddana may shena? amar leh: middehahi shata daamar leh lemar ikka milleta demitzva — assechay ledatay, vechol shata amena: hasheta kae mar, hasheta kae mar. amar leh: hav dataych veatne lich. hadar tena leh arba mea zimne [acharine].
Nefaka bat kala vaamar leh: nicha laych delispo lach arba mea shene, o detizko at vedarach lealma deate? amar: denizko ana vedarayy lealma deate. amar lahen hakkadosh baruch hu: tenu lo zo vazo.
Amar rav chisda: en tora niknet ella besimanin, shenneemar: "simah befihem", al tikre 'simah, ella 'sayyemennah.

Shama rav tachlifa mimmareva, azal amra kammeh derabbi avahu, amar: attun mehatam matnitu la, anan mehacha matninan la: "hatztzivi lach tziyyunim simi lach vegomer" — asu tziyyunim lattora. umay mashma dehay tziyyun lishshana desimana hu? dichtiv: "veraa etzem adam uvana etzlo tziyyun".
Rabbi eliezer amar, mehacha: "emor lachochma achoti at umoda labbina tikra" — ase modaim lattora. rava amar: ase moadim lattora.

a: Vehayeynu deamar avdimi bar chama bar dosa, may dichtiv: "lo vashshamayim hi velo meever layyam hi". "la bashshamayim hi", sheim bashshamayim hi — atta tzarich laalot achareha, veim meever layyam hi — atta tzarich laavor achareha.
Rava amar: "lo vashshamayim hi" — lo timmatze bemi shemmagbiah dato aleha kashshamayim, velo timmatze bemi shemmarchiv dato aleha kayyam.
Rabbi yochanan amar: "lo bashshamayim hi" — lo timmatze begassay ruach, "velo meever layyam hi" — lo timmatze lo besachranim velo betaggarim.

Tanu rabbanan: ketzad meabberin et hearim? arukka — kemot shehi. agulla — osin lah zaviyyot. merubbaat — en osin lah zaviyyot. hayta rechava mitztzad echad uketzara mitztzad acher — roin otah keillu hi shava.

Haya bayit echad yotze kemin piggum, o shene vattim yotzin kemin shene figgumin — roin otan keillu chut matuach alehen, umoded mimmennu ulehallan alpayim amma. hayta asuya kemin keshet o kemin gam — roin otah keillu hi melea battim vachatzerot, umoded mimmennu ulehallan alpayim amma.
Amar mar: arukka kemot shehi. peshita! la tzericha, daaricha vekattina, mahu detema: litten la puteya aureka. ka mashma lan.
Merubbaat en osin lah zaviyyot. peshita! la tzericha, dimrabbea, vela merabbea beribbua olam. mahu detema: lirabbea beribbua olam. ka mashma lan.
Haya bayit echad yotze kemin piggum o shene vattim yotzin kemin shene figgumin. hasheta bayit echad amrat, shene vattim mibbaya?!
La tzericha, mishte ruchot. mahu detema: meruach achat amrinan, mishte ruchot la amrinan. ka mashma lan.

Hayta asuya kemin keshet o kemin gam, roin otah keillu hi melea vattim vachatzerot, umoded mimmenna ulehallan alpayim amma. amar rav huna: ir haasuya kekeshet, im yesh ben shene rasheha pachot mearbaat alafim amma — moddin lah min hayyeter, veim lav — moddin lah min hakkeshet.
Umi amar rav huna hachi, vehaamar rav huna: chomat hair shennifretza — bemea vearbaim veachat ushelish?
Amar rabba bar ulla, la kashya: kan — beruach achat, kan — mishte ruchot.
Umay ka mashma lan? denotnin karpef lazo vekarpef lazo? ha amra rav huna chada zimna, ditnan:
b: Notnin karpef lair, divre rabbi meir. vachachamim omrim: lo amru karpef ella ben shete ayayrot.
Veittemar, rav huna amar: karpef lazo vekarpef lazo. vechiyyay bar rav amar: en notnin ella karpef echad lishnehem!
Tzericha, dei ashmeinan hacha — mishshum dahava leh tzad hetter meikkara. aval hatam, ema la.
Vei ashmeinan hatam — mishshum didchika tashmishtayyhu, aval hacha dela dechika tashmishtayyhu — ema la, tzericha.
Vechamma have ben yeter lakkeshet? rabba bar rav huna amar: alpayim amma, rava bereh derabba bar rav huna amar: afillu yater mealpayim amma.
Amar abbaye: kevoteh derava bereh derabba bar rav huna mistabbera, dei bae hadar ate derech battim.
Hayu sham gedudiyyot gevohot asara tefachim kulei. may gedudiyyot? amar rav yehuda: shalosh mechitztzot sheen alehen tikra.

Ibbaya lehu: shete mechitztzot veyesh alehen tikra, mahu? ta shema, ellu shemmitabberin immah: nefesh sheyyesh bah arba ammot al arba ammot, vehaggesher vehakkever sheyyesh bahen bet dira, uvet hakkeneset sheyyesh bah bet dira lachazzan, uvet avoda zara sheyyesh bah bet dira lakkomarim, vehaurevot vehaotzarot shebbassadot veyesh bahen bet dira, vehabbureganin shebbetochah, vehabbayit shebbayyam — hare ellu mitabberin immah.

Veellu sheen mitabberin immah: nefesh shennifretza mishte ruchoteha elach veelach, vehaggesher vehakkever sheen lahen bet dira, uvet hakkeneset sheen lah bet dira lachazzan, uvet avoda zara sheen lah bet dira lakkomarim, vehaurevot vehaotzarot shebbassadot sheen lahen bet dira, uvor veshiach umeara vegader veshovach shebbetochah, vehabbayit shebbassefina — en ellu mitabberin immah.
Katane mihat: nefesh shennifretza mishte ruchoteha elach veelach. may lav deikka tikra! la — delekka tikra.
Bayit shebbayyam. lemay chaze? amar rav pappa: bayit sheasuy lefannot bo kelim shebbassefina.
Umeara en mitabberet immah, vehatane rabbi chiyyay: meara mitabberet immah! amar abbaye: kesheyyesh binyan al piha.
Vetippok leh mishshum binyan gufeh! la tzericha, lehashelim.
Amar rav huna: yoshve tzerifin, en moddin lahen ella mippetach battehen.
Metiv rav chisda: "vayyachanu al hayyarden mibbet hayeshimot", veamar rabba bar bar chana (amar rabbi yochanan): ledidi chaze li hahu atra, vehave telata parse al telata parse.
Vetanya: keshehen nifnin — en nifnin lo lifnehem, velo letziddehen, ella leacharehen?
Amar leh rava: digle midbar kaamrat? kevan dichtiv behu: "al pi Adonai yachanu veal pi Adonai yissau" — keman dikvia lehu dame.
Amar rav chinnana bar rav kahana amar rav ashe: im yesh sham shalosh chatzerot shel shene vattim — hukebu.
Amar rav yehuda amar rav: yoshve tzerifin veholche midbarot — chayyehen enan chayyim, uneshehen uvenehen enan shellahen.
Tanya name hachi, eliezer ish birya omer: yoshve tzerifin keyoshve kevarim. veal benotehem hu omer: "arur shochev im kol behema".
May tama? ulla amar: sheen lahen merchatzaot. verabbi yochanan amar: mippene shemmargishin ze laze bitvila.
May benayyhu? ikka benayyhu nahara dismich leveta.

Amar rav huna: kol ir sheen bah yarak — en talmid chacham rashshay ladur bah. lememra deyarak mealleya? vehatanya: shelosha marbin et hazzevel, vechoffin et hakkoma, venotlin echad mechamesh meot mimmeor enav shel adam, veellu hen:

a: Pat kibbar veshechar chadash veyarak. la kashya: ha — betume vecharate, ha — bishar yarke. kidtanya: shum — yarak, kereshin — chatzi yarak, nire tzenon — nire sam chayyim.
Veha tanya: nire tzenon — nire sam hammavet! la kashya: kan — bealin, kan — baimmahot. kan — bimot hachamma, kan — bimot haggeshamim.

Amar rav yehuda amar rav: kol ir sheyyesh bah maalot umoradot, adam uvehema shebbah metim bachatzi yemehen. metim salka datach? ella ema: mazkinim bachatzi yemehen. amar rav huna bereh derav yehoshua: hane muleyayta deve vere udeve naresh azkenun.
Tanu rabbanan: ba lerabbeah — merabbeah beribbua olam, noten tzefonah litzfon olam uderomah lidrom olam, vesimanaych: agala batztzafon, veakrav baddarom.

Rabbi yose omer: im eno yodea lerabbeah beribbua shel olam, — merabbeah kemin hattekufa. ketzad? chamma yotza beyom aroch veshokaat beyom aroch — ze hu pene tzafon. chamma yotza beyom katzar veshokaat beyom katzar — ze hu pene darom. tekufat nisan utekufat tishre — chamma yotza bachatzi mizrach veshokaat bachatzi maarav,

Shenneemar: "holech el darom vesovev el tzafon", holech el darom — bayyom, vesovev el tzafon — ballayla. "sovev sovev holech haruach" — ellu pene mizrach ufene maarav, peamim mehallachtan ufeamim mesabbavtan.

Amar rav mesharsheya: letanhu lehane kelale, detanya: lo yatza chamma meolam mikkeren mizrachit tzefonit veshaka bekeren maaravit tzefonit, velo yatza chamma mikkeren mizrachit deromit veshaka bekeren maaravit deromit.
Amar shemuel: en tekufat nisan nofelet ella bearbaa rive hayyom, o bitchillat hayyom o bitchillat hallayla, o bachatzi hayyom o bachatzi hallayla.

Veen tekufat tammuz nofelet ella o beachat umechetza, o besheva umechetza, ben bayyom uven ballayla. veen tekufat tishre nofelet ella o beshalosh shaot o betesha shaot, ben bayyom uven ballayla. veen tekufat tevet nofelet ella o bearba umechetza o beeser umechetza, ben bayyom uven ballayla.
Veen ben tekufa litkufa ella tishim veechad yom vesheva shaot umechetza. veen tekufa moshechet mechavertah ella chatzi shaa.

Veamar shemuel: en lecha tekufat nisan shennofelet betzedek, sheenah meshabberet et hailanot. veen lecha tekufat tevet shennofelet betzedek, sheenah meyaybeshet et hazzeraim. vehu, deityelid levana o bilvana o betzedek.
b: Tanu rabbanan: hamerabbea et hair, ose otah kemin tavla merubbaat. vechozer umerabbea et hattechumin, veose otan kemin tavla merubbaat.
Ucheshehu moded, lo yimdod meemtza hakkeren alpayim amma mippene shehu mafsid et hazzaviyyot. ella mevi tavla merubbaat shehi alpayim amma al alpayim amma, umannichah bekeren baalachsonah.

Nimtzeta hair mistakkeret arba meot ammot lechan vearba meot ammot lechan. nimtzeu techumin mistakkerin shemone meot ammot lechan ushemone meot lechan. nimtzeu hair utechumin mistakkerin elef umatayim lechan veelef umatayim lechan.
Amar abbaye: umashkachat la bemata dehavya tere alfe attere alfe.
Tanya, amar rabbi eliezer berabbi yose: techum are leviyyim alpayim amma. tze mehen elef amma migrash — nimtza migrash revia, vehashshear sadot ucheramim.
Mena hane mille? amar rava: deamar kera: "mikkir hair vachutza elef amma saviv", amra tora: sabbev et hair beelef, nimtza migrash revia.

Revia?! palga have! amar rava: bar adda mashochaa asbera li — mashkachat la bemata dehavya tere alfe attere alfe. techum kamma havya? shittesar. keranot kamma havyayn? shittesar. dal temanya ditchumin vearbea dikranot, kamma have? teresar.
Nimtza migrash revia? tefe mittilta ninhu!
Ayyti arbea demata, shedi alayyhu. akkatti tilta have!
Mi savrat beribbua kaamar? beiggula kaamar.
Kamma merubba yater al heagol? revia, dal revia minnayyhu — pashu lehu tisha. vetisha mittelatin veshitta, riva have.
Abbaye amar: mashkachat la name bemata dehavya alfa bealfa. techumin kamma havu? temanya. keranot kamma have? shittesar.

a: Dal arba ditchumin vearba dikranot. kamma have? temanya.
Tilta havu! mi savrat beribbua kaamar? beiggula kaamar. kamma merubba yater al heagol — revia, dal revia — pashu la shitta. veshitta meesrim vearba, riva have.
Ravina amar: may revia, revia ditchumin.
Rav ashe amar: may revia, revia dikranot.
Amar leh ravina lerav ashe: veha "saviv" ketiv!

May "saviv" — saviv dikranot, dei la tema hachi, gabbe ola dichtiv: "vezarku (bene aharon) et haddam al hammizbeach saviv", hachi name saviv mammash?! ella may "saviv" — saviv dikranot, hachi name: may "saviv" — saviv dikranot.
Amar leh rav chavivi machoznaa lerav ashe: veha ikka muresha dekarnata!
Bemata igguleta. veha raybuha? emor deamrinan chazenan keman dimrabbea. rabboe vadday mi merabbana?!
Amar leh rav chanilay machoznaa lerav ashe: mikkedi kamma merubba yater al heagol — revia, hane tamne mea? shet mea veshittin usheva nache tilta have!
Amar leh: hane mille beiggula miggo ribbua. aval baalachsona — baena tefe. deamar mar, kol ammeta beribbua — ammeta utere chummeshe baalachsona.

Mishna notnin karpef lair, divre rabbi meir. vachachamim omrim: lo amru karpef ella ben shete ayayrot, im yesh lazo shivim amma veshirayim ulazo shivim amma veshirayim — ose karpef et shetehen lihyot echad.
Vechen shelosha kefarim hameshullashin, im yesh ben shenayim chitzonim mea vearbaim veachat ushelish — asa emtzai et shelashtan lihyot echad.
Gemara mena hane mille? amar rava: deamar kera: "mikkir hair vachutza". amra tora: ten chutza, veachar kach medod.
Vachachamim omrim lo amru vechulei. ittemar, rav huna amar: notnin karpef lazo vekarpef lazo. chiyyay bar rav amar: karpef [echad] lishtehen.
Tenan, vachachamim omrim: lo amru karpef ella ben shete ayayrot, teyuveta derav huna!
Amar lecha rav huna: may karpef, torat karpef, uleolam karpef lazo vekarpef lazo.
Hachi name mistabbera, middekatane sefa: im yesh lazo shivim amma veshirayim velazo shivim amma veshirayim — ose karpef lishtehen lihyot echad. shema minna.
Lema tehve teyuveteh dechiyyay bar rav! amar lecha chiyyay bar rav:
b: Ha manni — rabbi meir hi.
I rabbi meir hi, ha tane leh resha: notnin karpef lair, divre rabbi meir?
Tzericha, dei mehahi, hava amena: chad lachada, vechad letarte. ka mashma lan diltarte tere yahavinan lehu.
Vei ashmeinan hacha, mishshum didchika tashmishtayyhu, aval hatam dela dechika tashmishtayyhu, ema la, tzericha.

Tenan: vechen shelosha kefarim hameshullashin, im yesh ben shenayim hachitzonim mea vearbaim veachat amma ushelish — ose emtzai et shelashtan lihyot echad. tama deikka emtzai, ha lekka emtzai — lo. teyuveta derav huna!

Amar lecha rav huna: ha ittemar ala, amar rabba amar rav idi amar rabbi chanina: lo meshullashin mammash, ella roin kol sheillu metil emtzai benehen veyihyu meshullashin, veen ben ze laze ella mea vearbaim amma veachat ushelish — asa emtzai et shelashtan lihyot echad.
Amar leh rava leabbaye: kamma yehe ben chitzon laemtzai? amar leh: alpayim amma.
Veha at hu deamrat: kevoteh derava bereh derabba bar rav huna mistabbera, deamar: yoter mealpayim amma!
Hachi hasheta? hatam, ikka battim. hacha, lekka battim.
Vaamar leh rava leabbaye: kamma yehe ben chitzon lechitzon? kamma yehe?! may nafka lach minna? kol sheillu machnis emtzai benehen veen ben ze laze ella mea vearbaim veachat ushelish.
Vaafillu arbaat alpayim amma? amar leh: in. vehaamar rav huna: ir haasuya kekeshet, im yesh ben shene rasheha pachot mearbaat alafim amma moddin lah min hayyeter, veim lav moddin lah min hakkeshet!
Amar leh: hatam lekka lememar "malle". hacha ikka lememar "malle".

Amar leh rav safra lerava: hare bene akistefon, demashchinan lehu techuma mehay gisa deardashir, uvene techuma deardashir mashchinan lehu techuma mehay gisa daakistefon. ha ikka diglat demafseka yater mimmea vearbaim veachat ushelish?
Nefak, achvi leh hanach atmahata deshura, demibbali bediglat beshivim amma veshirayim.
Mishna en moddin ella bechevel shel chamishshim amma, lo pachot velo yoter. velo yimdod ella keneged libbo.
Haya moded vehiggia legay o legader, mavlio, vechozer lemiddato. higgia lehar, mavlio vechozer lemiddato.

a: Uvilvad shello yetze chutz lattechum.
Im eno yachol lehavelio — bezo amar rabbi dostay bar yannay mishshum rabbi meir: shamati shemmekadderin beharim.
Gemara mena hane mille? amar rav yehuda amar rav: deamar kera "orech hechatzer mea vaamma verochav chamishshim bachamishshim", amra tora: bechevel shel chamishshim amma medod.
Hay mibbee leh littol chamishshim ulesabbev chamishshim.
Im ken lema kera: "chamishshim chamishshim", may "chamishshim bachamishshim"? shamat minna tarte.
Lo pachot velo yoter. tana: lo pachot — mippene shemmarbe, velo yoter — mippene shemmemaet.

Amar rabbi assi: en moddin ella bechevel shel afsekima. may afsekima? amar rabbi abba: nargila. may nargila? amar rabbi yaakov: dikla dechad nevara. ikka deamri: may afsekima? rabbi abba amar: nargila, rabbi yaakov amar: dikla dechad nevara.
Tanya, amar rabbi yehoshua ben chananya: en lecha sheyyafe limdida yoter mishshalshelaot shel barzel, aval ma naase shehare amra tora: "uveyado chevel midda".
Vehachtiv: "uveyad haish kene hammidda"? hahu, letare.
Tane rav yosef, shelosha chavalim hem: shel magag, shel netzer, veshel pishtan.
Shel magag lefara, ditnan: kefatuha bechevel hammagag unetanuha al gav maarachtah. shel netzarim lesota, ditnan: veachar kach mevi chevel hammitzri vekoshro lemala middaddeha. shel pishtan limdida.
Haya moded vehiggia. middetane: "chozer lemiddato", mikkelal deim eno yachol lehavelio — holech lemakom sheyyachol lehavelio, umavlio, vetzofe keneged middato, vechozer.

Tenena leha, detanu rabbanan: haya moded vehiggia hammidda legay, im yachol lehavelio bechevel shel chamishshim amma — mavlio. veim lav — holech limkom sheyyachol lehavelio, umavlio, vetzofe vechozer lemiddato.
Im haya ge meukkam — makdir veole, makdir veyored. higgia lechotel — en omrim yikkov hakkotel, ella omdo veholech lo.
Veha anan tenan: mavlio vechozer lemiddato? hatam, nicha tashmishta. hacha, la nicha tashmishta.
Amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: lo shanu ella sheen chut hammishkolet yored kenegdo,
b: Aval chut hammishkolet yored kenegdo — moddo medida yafa.
Vechamma omko shel ge? amar rav yosef: alpayim.
Etiveh abbaye: amok mea verochav chamishshim — mavlio. veim lav — en mavlio? hu deamar kaacherim, detanya, acherim omrim: afillu amok alpayim verochav chamishshim — mavlio.
Ikka deamri, amar rav yosef: afillu yater mealpayim. keman? dela ketanna kamma vela kaacherim!
Hatam — sheen chut hammishkolet yored kenegdo. hacha — bechut hammishkolet yored kenegdo.
Vechi en chut hammishkolet yored kenegdo, ad kamma? amar avimi: arba. vechen tane rame bar yechezkel: arba.
Higgia lehar, mavlio vechozer lemiddato. amar rava: lo shanu ella behar hammitlakket asara mittoch arba, aval behar hammitlakket asara mittoch chamesh — moddo medida yafa.
Rav huna bereh derav natan matne lekulla. amar rava: lo shanu ella behar hammitlakket asara mittoch chamesh, aval behar hammitlakket asara mittoch arba — omdo veholech lo.
Uvilvad shello yetze chutz lattechum. may tama? amar rav kahana: gezera shemma yomru middat techumin baa lechan.
Im eno yachol lehavelio. tanu rabbanan: ketzad mekadderin, tachton keneged libbo, elyon keneged margelotav. amar abbaye: nekitinan en mekadderin ella bechevel shel arba ammot.
Amar rav nachman amar rabba bar avu: (nekitinan) en mekadderin lo beegla arufa velo beare miklat — mippene shehen shel tora.
Mishna en moddin ella min hammumeche. ribba lemakom echad, umiet lemakom acher — shomin limkom sheribba. ribba leechad umiet leechad — shomin lamrubbe.
Vaafillu eved afillu shifcha neemanin lomar ad kan techum shabbat, shello amru chachamim et haddavar lehachamir, ella lehakel.

a: Gemara limkom sheribba in, limkom shemmiet la? ema: af limkom sheribba.
Ribba leechad umiet leechad kulei. ha tu lema li? hayeynu hach! hachi kaamar: ribba echad umiet echad — shomin leze sheribba.
Amar abbaye: uvilvad shello yarbe yoter mimmiddat hair baalachsona.
Shello amru chachamim et haddavar lehachamir ella lehakel. vehatanya: lo amru chachamim et haddavar lehakel ella lehachamir?
Amar ravina: lo lehakel al divre tora, ella lehachemir al divre tora, utechumin derabbanan.
Mishna ir shel yachid, venaaset shel rabbim — mearvin et kullah.

Veshel rabbim venaaset shel yachid — en mearvin et kullah ella im ken asa chutza lah. kair chadasha shebbihuda, sheyyesh bah chamishshim dayorin, divre rabbi yehuda. rabbi shimon omer: shalosh chatzerot shel shene vattim.
Gemara hechi dame ir shel yachid venaaset shel rabbim? amar rav yehuda: kegon diyskarta deresh galuta.

Amar leh rav nachman: may tama? illema mishshum dishchichi gabbe haremana, madkeri ahadade — kullehu yisrael name betzafra deshabbeta shechichi gabbe hadade. ella amar rav nachman: kegon diskarta denattezui.

Tanu rabbanan: ir shel yachid venaaset shel rabbim ureshut harabbim overet betochah, ketzad mearvin otah? ose lechi mikkan velechi mikkan, o kora mikkan vekora mikkan, venose venoten baemtza. veen mearvin otah lachatzain, ella o kullah, o mavoy mavoy bifne atzmo.
Hayta shel rabbim, vahare hi shel rabbim
b: Veen lah ella petach echad — mearvin et kullah.

Man tanna demiarva reshut harabbim? amar rav huna bereh derav yehoshua: rabbi yehuda hi, detanya: yater al ken amar rabbi yehuda: mi sheyyesh lo shene battim bishne tzidde reshut harabbim — ose lechi mikkan velechi mikkan, o kora mikkan vekora mikkan, venose venoten baemtza. amru lo: en mearvin reshut harabbim bechach.
Amar mar: veen mearvin otah lachatzain. amar rav pappa: lo amru ella leorkah, aval lerochbah — mearvin.
Keman — dela kerabbi akiva. dei kerabbi akiva, ha amar: regel hammutteret bimkomah — oseret afillu shello bimkomah.
