Afillu tema rabbi akiva: ad kan la kaamar rabbi akiva hatam ella bishte chatzerot zo lefanim mizzo, difnimit let la pitcha acharina. aval hacha, hane nafki behay pitcha, vehane nafki behay pitcha.
Ikka deamri, amar rav pappa: la tema leorkah hu dela mearvin, aval lerochbah mearvin, ella afillu lerochbah name la mearvin.

Keman, kerabbi akiva! afillu tema rabbanan, ad kan la kaamri rabbanan hatam ella bishte chatzerot zo lifnim mizzo, difnimit achada ledashsha umishtammesha. aval hacha, mi matzu mesalleki reshut harabbim mehacha?!
Amar mar: o kullah, o mavoy mavoy bifne atzmo. may shena delachatzain dela — deasri ahadade, mavoy mavoy name asri ahadade?!
Hacha bemay askinan, kegon daavud dakka. vechi ha deamar rav idi bar avin amar rav chisda: echad mibbene mavoy sheasa dakka lefitcho — eno oser al bene mavoy.
Hayta shel rabbim vahare hi kulei. rabbi zera arva lemata deve rabbi chiyyay, vela shevak la shiyyur. amar leh abbaye: may tama avad mar hachi?
Amar leh, save dida amri li: rav chiyyay bar assi mearev kulla. veamena: shema minna ir shel yachid venaaset shel rabbim hi.
Amar leh, ledidi amaru li hanhu save: hahi ashpa hava la mechad gisa. vehasheta deippanya la ashpa, have la kishne petachim vaasir. amar leh: lav addatay.
Bae minneh rav amme bar adda harepannaa merabba: sullam mikkan ufetach mikkan, mahu? amar leh, hachi amar rav: sullam torat petach alav.

Amar lehu rav nachman: la tetzitu leh, hachi amar rav adda amar rav: sullam torat petach alav, vetorat mechitza alav. torat mechitza alav, kedaamaran. torat petach alav, besullam shebben shete chatzerot, ratzu — echad mearev, ratzu — shenayim mearvin.
Umi amar rav nachman hachi? vehaamar rav nachman amar shemuel: anshe chatzer veanshe mirpeset sheshshachchu

a: Velo ervu, im yesh lifnehem dakka arbaa — enah oseret, veim lav — oseret.
Hacha bemay askinan, bidlo gevoha mirpeset asara.
Vei lo gevoha mirpeset asara, ki ka aved dakka, may have? bimguppefet ad eser ammot, dechevan deaved dakka — istalloke istalluk leh mehacha.
Amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: kotel shertzafah besullamot, afillu beyater meeser — torat mechitza alav.

Rame leh rav berona lerav yehuda bematzarta deve rav chanina: mi amar shemuel torat mechitza alav? vehaamar rav nachman amar shemuel: anshe mirpeset veanshe chatzer sheshshachchu velo ervu, im yesh lefaneha dakka arbaa enah oseret, veim lav — oseret.
Hacha bemay askinan, delo gevoha mirpeset asara. vei lo gevoha mirpeset asara, ki aved dakka may have? bimguppefet ad eser ammot, dechevan deaved dakka — istalloke istallak mehacha.

Hanhu bene kakunae deate lekammeh derav yosef, amaru leh: hav lan gavra deliarev lan matin. amar leh leabbaye: zil arev lehu, vachazi dela metzavvchat ala beve midresha. azal, chaza lehanhu batte diftichi lenahara. amar: hane leheve shiyyur lemata.
Hadar amar: "en mearvin et kullah" tenan, [mikkelal] dei bae leayrove, matze mearvi. ella ebed lehu kavvevy, dei bau leayrove derech challonot matzu mearvi.

Hadar amar: la bae, deha rabba bar avu mearev la lechulla machoza arseyayta arseyayta mishshum pera deve tore, dechol chad vechad have shiyyur lechavreh. veaf al gav dei bau learove bahade hadade, la matzu mearvi.
Hadar amar: la dame. hatam, i bae — learove derech gaggot, vehane la mearvi, hilkach nabedan kavvevy.
Hadar amar: kavvevy name la bae, dehahu be tivna dahava leh lemar bar pofidta mippumebdita, veshavveya shiyyur lefumebdita.
Amar, hayeynu deamar li mar: "chazi dela metzavvchat ala beve midresha".

Ella im ken asa chutza lah kair chadasha. tanya, amar rabbi yehuda: ir achat hayta bihuda vachadasha shemah, vehayu bah chamishshim dayorim anashim venashim vataf, uvah hayu meshaarim chachamim, vehi hayta shiyyur.
Ibbaya lehu: chadasha mahu? chadasha, ki hechi deihi havya shiyyur ligdola — gedola name havya shiyyur liktanna.
Ella keen chadasha, mahu? rav huna verav yehuda, chad amar: baaya shiyyur, vechad amar: la baaya shiyyur.

Rabbi shimon omer shalosh chatzerot vechulei. amar rav chama bar gureya amar rav: halacha kerabbi shimon. rabbi yitzchak amar: afillu bayit echad vechatzer achat. chatzer achat salka datach?! ella ema: bayit echad bechatzer achat.
Amar leh abbaye lerav yosef: ha derabbi yitzchak, gemara o sevara? amar leh: may nafka lan minna? amar leh: gemara gemor, zemorta tehe?!

Mishna mi shehaya bammizrach veamar livno: "arev li bammaarav", bammaarav vaamar livno: "arev li bammizrach", im yesh hemennu uleveto alpayim amma, uleeruvo yoter mikkan — muttar leveto, veasur leeruvo.
Leeruvo alpayim amma, uleveto yater mikkan — asur leveto, umuttar leeruvo.
Hannoten et eruvo beibburah shel ir, lo asa velo chelum.
Netano chutz lattechum, afillu amma achat —
b: Ma shenniskar hu mafsid.
Gemara ka salka datach: "lammizrach", lemizrach beto. "lammaarav", lemaarav beto.
Bishlama "hemennu uleveto alpayim amma uleeruvo yater mikkan" — mashkachat la, demate leveteh vela mate leeruvo, ella "hemennu uleeruvo alpayim amma uleveto yater mikkan" — hechi mashkachat la?
Amar rabbi yitzchak: mi savrat "lammizrach" — lemizrach beto, "lammaarav" — lemaarav beto?! lo, "lammizrach" — lemizrach beno, "lammaarav" — lemaarav beno.
Rava bar rav shela amar: afillu tema "lammizrach" — lemizrach beto, velammaarav" — lemaarav beto, kegon dekae beteh baalachsona.
Hannoten eruvo betoch ibburah vechulei. chutz lattechum salka datach? ella ema: chutz leibburah.

Ma shenniskar hu mafsid. ma shenniskar vetu la?! vehatanya: hannoten et eruvo betoch ibburah shel ir, lo asa velo chelum. netano chutz leibburah shel ir afillu amma achat, mistakker otah amma umafsid et kol hair kullah, mippene shemmiddat hair ola lo bemiddat hattechum!
La kashya: kan shekkalta middato bachatzi hair, kan shekkalta middato besof hair.

Vechidrabbi idi, deamar rabbi idi amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: haya moded uva vechalta middato bachatzi hair — en lo ella chatzi hair. kalta middato besof hair — naaset lo hair kullah kearba ammot, umashlimin lo et hashshear.
Amar rabbi idi: en ellu ella divre neviut. ma li kalta bachatzi hair, ma li kalta besof hair?
Amar rava, tarvayyhu tenanhi: anshe ir gedola mehallechin et kol ir ketanna.

a: Veen anshe ir ketanna mehallechin et kol ir gedola.
May tama — lav mishshum dehane kalta middatan bachatzi hair, vehane kalta middatan besof hair.
Verabbi idi, "anshe anshe" tane, umokem lah benoten. aval moded la tenan.
Vela?! vehatnan: velammoded sheamru notnin lo alpayim amma, sheafillu sof middato kale bimara!
Sof hair itztericha leh, dela tenan.
Amar rav nachman: man detane "anshe" la mishtabbash, uman detane "en anshe" la mishtabbash.
Man detane "anshe" la mishtabbash — demokem la benoten. uman detane "en anshe" la mishtabbash — demokem la bemoded.

Vechassore mechassera, vehachi katane: anshe ir gedola mehallechin et kol ir ketanna, veen anshe ir ketanna mehallechin et kol ir gedola. bamme devarim amurim, bemoded. aval mi shehaya beir gedola vehinniach et eruvo beir ketanna, haya beir ketanna vehinniach et eruvo beir gedola — mehallech et kullah vechutza lah alpayim amma.
Amar rav yosef amar rame bar abba amar rav huna: ir sheyyoshevet al sefat hannachal, im yesh lefaneha dakka arbaa — moddim lah missefat hannachal. veim lav — en moddin lah ella mippetach beto.
Amar leh abbaye: dakka arba ammot amart lan ala. may shena mikkol dakke dealma dearbea?
Amar leh: hatam, la beita tashmishta. hacha, beita tashmishta.
Amar rav yosef: mena amena la? detanya: hittir rabbi sheyyehu bene gader yordin lechammatan, veen bene chammatan olin legader. may tama, lav mishshum dehane avud dakka, vehane la avud dakka?!
Ki ata rav dimi amar: tatroge metatregi lehu bene gader livne chammatan, umay "hittir" — hitkin.
Umay shena shabbat, dishchicha bah shichrut.
Ki azli lehatam, name metatregi lehu? kalba bela mateh, shav shenin la navach.
Hasheta name metatregi bene chammatan livne gader! kulle hay la kayyfi lehu.
Rav safra amar: ir haasuya kekeshet havay.
Rav dimi bar chinnana amar: anshe ir gedola veanshe ir ketanna havay.
Rav kahana matne hachi. rav tavyome matne hachi: rav safra verav dimi bar chinnana, chad amar: ir haasuya kekeshet havay, vechad amar: anshe ir ketanna veanshe ir gedola havay.

Mishna anshe ir gedola mehallechin et kol ir ketanna, veanshe ir ketanna mehallechin et kol ir gedola. ketzad? mi shehaya beir gedola venatan et eruvo beir ketanna, beir ketanna venatan et eruvo beir gedola — mehallech et kullah, vechutza lah alpayim amma.
Rabbi akiva omer: en lo ella mimmekom eruvo alpayim amma. amar lahen rabbi akiva: i attem modim li benoten eruvo bimara, sheen lo ella mimmekom eruvo alpayim amma?
Amru lo: ematay — bizman sheen bah dayorin, aval yesh bah dayorin — mehallech et kullah vechutza lah alpayim amma. nimtza, kal tochah meal gabbah.
Velammoded sheamru notnin alpayim amma — sheafillu sof middato kale bimara.
b: Gemara amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: shavat beir chareva, lerabbanan mehallech et kullah vechutza lah alpayim amma. hinniach et eruvo beir chareva — en lo mimmekom eruvo ella alpayim amma. rabbi elazar omer: echad shavat veechad hinniach — mehallech et kullah vechutza lah alpayim amma.
Metivi, amar lahen rabbi akiva: i attem modim li benoten et eruvo bimara, sheen lo mimmekom eruvo ella alpayim amma? amru lo: ematay, bizman sheen bah dayorin. ha been bah dayorin modu leh?!
May "en bah dayorin" — enah reuya ledira.

Ta shema: shavat beir, afillu hi gedola keantiyyochya, bimara, afillu hi kimarat tzidkiyyahu melech yehuda — mehallech et kullah vechutza lah alpayim amma. katane ir dumeya dimara, ma meara chareva, af ir chareva. veshavat in, aval hinniach la.
Manni, ilema rabbi akiva, may irya chareva? afillu yeshiva name! ella lav rabbanan, vetama deshavat in, aval hinniach — la!
La tema ir dumeya dimara, ella ema meara dumeya deir. ma ir yeshiva, af meara yeshiva. verabbi akiva hi, deamar: en lo mimmekom eruvo ella alpayim amma, uveshavat mode.
Veha kimarat tzidkiyyahu katane! kimarat tzidkiyyahu, velo kimarat tzidkiyyahu. kimarat tzidkiyyahu — gedola. velo kimarat tzidkiyyahu — deillu hatam chareva, vehacha yeshiva.
Mar yehuda ashkechinhu livne mevarachta deka motvi eruvayyhu beve kenishta deve aggovar, amar lehu: gauo beh tefe, ki hechi delishtere lechu tefe.
Amar leh rava: palgaa, beeruvin let dechash leha derabbi akiva.
Haderan alach ketzad meabberin
Mishna haddar im hannochri bechatzer, o im mi sheeno mode baeruv — hare ze oser alav.
Rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer: leolam eno oser ad sheyyehu shene yisreelim osrin ze al ze.
Amar rabban gamliel: maase betzadduki echad shehaya dar immanu bemavoy birushalayim, veamar lanu abba: maharu vehotziu et hakkelim lammavoy, ad shello yotzi veyeesor alechem.
Rabbi yehuda omer: belashon acher — maharu vaasu tzorchechem bammavoy, ad shello yotzi veyeesor alechem.

a: Gemara yatev abbaye bar avin verav chinnana bar avin, veyatev abbaye gabbayyhu, veyatvi vekaamri: bishlama rabbi meir kasavar dirat goy shemah dira, vela shena chad vela shena tere.
Ella rabbi eliezer ben yaakov may kasavar? i kasavar dirat goy shemah dira — afillu chad name nittesar! vei la shemah dira — afillu tere name la nittesar!
Amar lehu abbaye: vesavar rabbi meir dirat goy shemah dira? vehatanya: chatzero shel nochri — hare hu kedir shel behema.
Ella: dechulle alma dirat goy lo shemah dira, vehacha bigzera shemma yilmad mimmaasav ka mippalgi.
Rabbi eliezer ben yaakov savar: kevan degoy chashud ashshefichut damim, tere dishchichi dedayyri — gezaru behu, chad la shechiach — la gezaru beh rabbanan.
Verabbi meir savar: zimnin demikkere vedayer. vaamaru rabbanan: en eruv moil bimkom goy, veen bittul reshut moil bimkom goy, ad sheyyaskir. vegoy la mogar.
May tama? illema mishshum desavar: dilma ate leachzoke birshuto, hanicha leman deamar: sechirut beria bainan.
Ella leman deamar: sechirut reua bainan, may ikka lememar? deittemar, rav chisda amar: sechirut beria. verav sheshet amar: sechirut reua.

May reua, may beria? illema: beria — bifruta, reua — pachot mishshave peruta. mi ikka leman deamar miggoy befachot mishshave peruta la? veha shalach rabbi yitzchak berabbi yaakov bar giyyore mishshemeh derabbi yochanan: havo yodin shessochrin min haggoy afillu befachot mishshave peruta.
Veamar rabbi chiyyay bar abba amar rabbi yochanan: ben noach neherag al pachot mishshave peruta, velo nittan lehishshavon.
Ella: beria — bemuherke vavuregane, reua — bela muherke vavuregane. hanicha leman deamar: sechirut beria bainan.
Ella leman deamar: sechirut reua bainan, may ikka lememar? afillu hachi chashesh goy lichshafim, vela mogar.
Gufa: chatzero shel goy hare hu kedir shel behema, umuttar lehachenis ulehotzi min chatzer labbattim umin battim lechatzer.
Veim yesh sham yisrael echad — oser, divre rabbi meir.
Rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer: leolam eno oser ad sheyyehu shene yisreelim osrim ze al ze.
b: Amar mar: chatzero shel goy hare hu kedir shel behema. veha anan tenan: haddar im hannochri bechatzer hare ze oser alav!
La kashya: ha — deiteh. ha — deleteh.
Umay kasavar? i kasavar dira belo bealim shemah dira — afillu goy name nittesar. vei kasavar dira belo bealim lo shemah dira — afillu yisrael name la nittesar!
Leolam kasavar dira belo bealim — lo shemah dira. veyisrael, dechi iteh asar, ki leteh — gezaru beh rabbanan.
Goy, dechi iteh — gezera shemma yilmad mimmaasav. ki iteh — asar, ki leteh — la asar.
Vechi leteh, la asar? vehatnan: hammanniach et beto vehalach lo lishbot beir acheret, echad nochri veechad yisrael oser, divre rabbi meir.
Hatam deate beyomeh.
Amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: halacha kerabbi eliezer ben yaakov. verav huna amar: minhag kerabbi eliezer ben yaakov. verabbi yochanan amar: nahagu haam kerabbi eliezer ben yaakov.
Amar leh abbaye lerav yosef: kayyma lan mishnat rabbi eliezer ben yaakov kav venaki, veamar rav yehuda amar shemuel: halacha kerabbi eliezer ben yaakov.
Mahu leoroye bimkom rabbo?
Amar leh: afillu beata bechuttacha beo minneh merav chisda kol shene derav huna, vela ori.

Amar leh rabbi yaakov bar abba leabbaye: kegon megillat taanit dichtiva umannecha. mahu leoroye beatreh derabbeh? amar leh, hachi amar rav yosef: afillu beata bechuttacha beo minneh merav chisda kol shene derav huna, vela ori.
Rav chisda ori bechafri bishne derav huna.
